ko.title: 세금 신고 시즌 미리보기: 새로운 팁, 초과 근무 및 고령자 공제가 2026년 신고서에 미치는 영향

segments.src: When filing season opens in early 2027, millions of taxpayers will meet several new lines on their returns.
segments.tr: 2027년 초 신고 시즌이 시작되면 수백만 명의 납세자가 신고서에서 몇 가지 새로운 항목을 보게 될 것입니다.

segments.src: The 2025 federal tax law, known as the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, created temporary deductions for qualified tip income, qualified overtime pay and older adults.
segments.tr: '원 빅 뷰티풀 빌 액트(One Big Beautiful Bill Act)'로 알려진 2025년 연방 세법은 적격 팁 소득, 적격 초과 근무 수당 및 고령자를 위한 임시 공제를 신설했습니다.

segments.src: It also created one for interest on certain new auto loans.
segments.tr: 또한 특정 신차 자동차 대출에 대한 이자 공제도 신설했습니다.

segments.src: Some workers filed with these items for tax year 2025.
segments.tr: 일부 근로자는 2025 과세 연도에 이러한 항목으로 신고를 마쳤습니다.

segments.src: For others, the 2026 return will be the first time they matter in a big way.
segments.tr: 다른 이들에게는 2026년 신고서가 이러한 항목들이 큰 의미를 갖는 첫 번째 해가 될 것입니다.

segments.src: The details are specific, and the rules are easy to misread.
segments.tr: 세부 사항이 구체적이어서 규칙을 오인하기 쉽습니다.

segments.src: This guide explains who may qualify, what records are worth keeping now, and how paycheck withholding can change your refund.
segments.tr: 이 가이드는 누가 자격을 갖추고 있는지, 지금 보관해야 할 가치 있는 기록은 무엇인지, 그리고 원천징수가 환급액을 어떻게 바꿀 수 있는지 설명합니다.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not tax advice.
segments.tr: *이 문서는 일반적인 정보 제공을 위한 것이며 세무 자문이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Rules, forms and IRS guidance can change, so check current IRS materials or talk to a qualified tax professional about your own situation.*
segments.tr: 규칙, 양식 및 국세청(IRS) 지침은 변경될 수 있으므로, 최신 IRS 자료를 확인하거나 본인의 상황에 대해 자격을 갖춘 세무 전문가와 상담하세요.*

segments.src: ## The Big Picture: Deductions, Not Credits
segments.tr: ## 전체적인 개요: 세액 공제가 아닌 소득 공제

segments.src: These provisions are **deductions**, not credits.
segments.tr: 이러한 조항은 세액 공제가 아니라 **소득 공제**입니다.

segments.src: A deduction lowers the income your tax is calculated on.
segments.tr: 소득 공제는 세금이 계산되는 기준이 되는 소득을 낮춰줍니다.

segments.src: A credit lowers the tax itself, dollar for dollar.
segments.tr: 세액 공제는 세금 자체를 1대 1로 줄여줍니다.

segments.src: A $1,000 deduction therefore saves you roughly $100 to $370 in federal tax, depending on your tax bracket.
segments.tr: 따라서 1,000달러의 공제는 세율에 따라 연방 세금을 대략 100달러에서 370달러 정도 절감해 줍니다.

segments.src: It does not save you $1,000.
segments.tr: 1,000달러를 그대로 아껴주는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: Under the law, these deductions are generally available whether or not you itemize.
segments.tr: 법에 따라 이러한 공제는 일반적으로 항목별 공제 여부와 상관없이 적용받을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: You can usually claim them on top of the standard deduction.
segments.tr: 일반적으로 표준 공제 외에 추가로 청구할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: They are scheduled to apply to tax years 2025 through 2028 unless Congress changes them.
segments.tr: 의회가 변경하지 않는 한 2025 과세 연도부터 2028 과세 연도까지 적용될 예정입니다.

segments.src: ## The Tips Deduction
segments.tr: ## 팁 공제

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Workers who receive tips in an occupation that customarily and regularly received tips before 2025.
segments.tr: **자격 요건:** 2025년 이전부터 관례적이고 정기적으로 팁을 받는 직업에서 팁을 받는 근로자.

segments.src: The Treasury Department published a list of qualifying occupations.
segments.tr: 재무부는 적격 직업 목록을 발표했습니다.

segments.src: It includes jobs such as servers, bartenders, hotel workers, hair and beauty professionals, and delivery drivers.
segments.tr: 여기에는 서버, 바텐더, 호텔 직원, 헤어 및 뷰티 전문가, 배달 기사 등의 직종이 포함됩니다.

segments.src: Check the current list for your job.
segments.tr: 본인의 직업에 대해 최신 목록을 확인하세요.

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **주요 포인트:**

segments.src: - The deduction is capped at **$25,000** per return for qualified tips.
segments.tr: - 적격 팁에 대한 공제는 신고서당 **$25,000**로 한도가 설정됩니다.

segments.src: - The tips must be voluntary. A mandatory service charge added to a bill generally does not count.
segments.tr: - 팁은 자발적인 것이어야 합니다. 고지서에 추가된 의무 서비스 요금은 일반적으로 인정되지 않습니다.

segments.src: - The deduction begins to phase out when modified adjusted gross income (MAGI) exceeds roughly **$150,000** for single filers and **$300,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - 조정 총소득(MAGI)이 단독 신고자의 경우 약 **$150,000**, 공동 신고자의 경우 약 **$300,000**를 초과하면 공제액이 점진적으로 축소(phase out)되기 시작합니다.

segments.src: - Self-employed people may qualify in some cases, but the deduction cannot exceed the net income from the business that earned the tips. Certain specified service trades or businesses are excluded.
segments.tr: - 자영업자도 경우에 따라 자격이 될 수 있지만, 공제액은 팁을 얻은 사업의 순소득을 초과할 수 없습니다. 특정 지정 서비스 업종이나 사업은 제외됩니다.

segments.src: - Married couples generally must file jointly to claim it, and a valid Social Security number is required.
segments.tr: - 기혼 부부는 일반적으로 공제를 받기 위해 공동으로 신고해야 하며, 유효한 사회보장번호(Social Security number)가 필요합니다.

segments.src: - This deduction applies to federal income tax. Social Security and Medicare payroll taxes still apply to tips.
segments.tr: - 이 공제는 연방 소득세에 적용됩니다. 사회보장 및 메디케어 급여세는 팁에 계속 적용됩니다.

segments.src: ## The Overtime Deduction
segments.tr: ## 초과 근무 공제

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Employees who are paid overtime required under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).
segments.tr: **자격 요건:** 공정근로기준법(FLSA)에 따라 요구되는 초과 근무 수당을 받는 직원.

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **주요 포인트:**

segments.src: - Only the "premium" portion of overtime counts. If you earn time-and-a-half, the deduction covers the extra half, not the full hourly rate for those hours.
segments.tr: - 초과 근무의 "프리미엄" 부분만 계산됩니다. 1.5배의 시급을 받는 경우, 공제는 해당 시간에 대한 전체 시급이 아니라 추가된 절반에만 적용됩니다.

segments.src: - The maximum deduction is **$12,500** for single filers and **$25,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - 최대 공제액은 단독 신고자의 경우 **$12,500**, 공동 신고자의 경우 **$25,000**입니다.

segments.src: - The same MAGI phase-out thresholds apply as for tips (roughly $150,000 single, $300,000 joint).
segments.tr: - 팁과 동일한 MAGI 단계적 축소 기준(단독 약 $150,000, 공동 약 $300,000)이 적용됩니다.

segments.src: - Overtime paid under a union contract or company policy that goes beyond what the FLSA requires may not qualify.
segments.tr: - FLSA에서 요구하는 수준을 넘어선 노동조합 계약이나 회사 정책에 따라 지급된 초과 근무 수당은 자격이 되지 않을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - A valid Social Security number is required, and married couples generally must file jointly.
segments.tr: - 유효한 사회보장번호가 필요하며, 기혼 부부는 일반적으로 공동으로 신고해야 합니다.

segments.src: ## The Senior Deduction
segments.tr: ## 고령자 공제

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Taxpayers who are age 65 or older by the end of the tax year.
segments.tr: **자격 요건:** 과세 연도 말 기준으로 만 65세 이상인 납세자.

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **주요 포인트:**

segments.src: - The additional deduction is **$6,000 per eligible person**. A married couple where both spouses are 65 or older could claim up to $12,000.
segments.tr: - 추가 공제액은 **적격자 1인당 $6,000**입니다. 부부 모두 65세 이상인 기혼 부부는 최대 12,000달러까지 공제받을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - It phases out at a rate of 6 cents per dollar of MAGI above about **$75,000** for single filers and **$150,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - 단독 신고자 약 **$75,000**, 공동 신고자 약 **$150,000**를 초과하는 MAGI 1달러당 6센트의 비율로 축소됩니다.

segments.src: - It is separate from the existing additional standard deduction for people 65 and older, so the two can stack.
segments.tr: - 65세 이상 고령자를 위한 기존의 추가 표준 공제와는 별개이므로 두 공제를 중복해서 받을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - You must include a valid Social Security number for each person claimed.
segments.tr: - 공제를 받는 사람마다 유효한 사회보장번호를 기재해야 합니다.

segments.src: ## Auto Loan Interest, Briefly
segments.tr: ## 자동차 대출 이자 간략히 알아보기

segments.src: A related deduction covers up to **$10,000** of interest a year on a loan for a qualifying new vehicle.
segments.tr: 관련 공제는 적격 신차 대출에 대한 연간 최대 **$10,000**의 이자를 다룹니다.

segments.src: The vehicle must have final assembly in the United States, and the loan must have been taken out after 2024.
segments.tr: 차량은 미국에서 최종 조립되어야 하며, 대출은 2024년 이후에 실행된 것이어야 합니다.

segments.src: Income limits apply.
segments.tr: 소득 한도가 적용됩니다.

segments.src: If you bought a car recently, keep your loan statements.
segments.tr: 최근에 차를 구입했다면 대출 명세서를 보관하세요.

segments.src: ## Records to Keep Now
segments.tr: ## 지금 보관해야 할 기록

segments.src: The best way to claim these deductions is to document your income as you earn it.
segments.tr: 이러한 공제를 받는 가장 좋은 방법은 소득이 발생할 때마다 기록을 남기는 것입니다.

segments.src: Consider these steps before the year ends:
segments.tr: 연도가 끝나기 전에 다음 단계를 고려해 보세요:

segments.src: 1. **Tipped workers:** Keep a daily log of cash tips, plus card and app tips. Save statements from your employer's payroll or point-of-sale system. If you work through a delivery or rideshare platform, download your year-end earnings summaries.
segments.tr: 1. **팁을 받는 근로자:** 현금 팁, 카드 및 앱 팁의 일일 기록을 유지하세요. 고용주의 급여 명세서나 포스(POS) 시스템의 명세서를 저장하세요. 배달이나 차량 공유 플랫폼을 통해 일하는 경우 연말 소득 요약본을 다운로드하세요.

segments.src: 2. **Overtime earners:** Keep your pay stubs. Make sure you can see regular hours, overtime hours and the overtime rate. Ask your payroll department how overtime is labeled.
segments.tr: 2. **초과 근무 근로자:** 급여 명세서를 보관하세요. 정규 근무 시간, 초과 근무 시간, 초과 근무 수당 시급을 확인할 수 있는지 확인하세요. 급여 부서에 초과 근무가 어떻게 표시되는지 문의하세요.

segments.src: 3. **Older adults:** Confirm your date of birth and Social Security number on all your tax records. If you are married, confirm the same for your spouse.
segments.tr: 3. **고령자:** 모든 세금 기록에서 생년월일과 사회보장번호를 확인하세요. 기혼인 경우 배우자의 정보도 동일하게 확인하세요.

segments.src: 4. **Car buyers:** Save the loan agreement, the vehicle identification number (VIN) and interest statements.
segments.tr: 4. **차량 구매자:** 대출 약정서, 차량 식별 번호(VIN), 이자 명세서를 보관하세요.

segments.src: 5. **Everyone:** Look at your last pay stub of the year and compare it with the W-2 you receive in January. The IRS has been working with employers on new reporting. Expect separate reporting for qualified tips and overtime, but not every employer will have fully adapted. If your W-2 does not break out these amounts, you may need your own records to support the deduction.
segments.tr: 5. **모든 분:** 연도의 마지막 급여 명세서를 확인하고 1월에 받는 W-2와 비교해 보세요. IRS는 새로운 보고와 관련하여 고용주들과 협력해 왔습니다. 적격 팁과 초과 근무에 대한 별도의 보고가 예상되지만, 모든 고용주가 완전히 적응한 것은 아닙니다. W-2에 이러한 금액이 구분되어 있지 않은 경우, 공제를 뒷받침하기 위해 본인의 기록이 필요할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## How Withholding Could Affect Your Refund
segments.tr: ## 원천징수가 환급액에 미치는 영향

segments.src: Your refund is simply the difference between what was withheld from your pay during the year and what you actually owe.
segments.tr: 환급액은 단순히 연중 급여에서 원천징수된 금액과 실제로 납부해야 할 금액의 차이입니다.

segments.src: These new deductions reduce what you owe.
segments.tr: 이러한 새로운 공제는 납부해야 할 세금을 줄여줍니다.

segments.src: They do not automatically reduce what your employer withholds, unless you or your employer adjusts it.
segments.tr: 본인이나 고용주가 조정하지 않는 한, 고용주가 원천징수하는 금액이 자동으로 줄어들지는 않습니다.

segments.src: - **If your withholding did not change,** you may be overpaying during the year and get a **larger refund** after you claim the deductions.
segments.tr: - **원천징수액에 변동이 없는 경우,** 연중 세금을 초과 납부하고 있을 수 있으며 공제를 청구한 후 **더 큰 환급액**을 받게 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **If you want more take-home pay now,** you can submit a new Form W-4 to your employer, using the deductions worksheet to account for the new deductions. The IRS Tax Withholding Estimator at IRS.gov can help you pick sensible numbers.
segments.tr: - **현재 실수령액을 늘리고 싶다면,** 새로운 공제를 반영하는 공제 워크시트를 사용하여 고용주에게 새로운 W-4 양식을 제출할 수 있습니다. IRS.gov의 IRS 세금 원천징수 견적기(Tax Withholding Estimator)가 합리적인 숫자를 선택하는 데 도움을 줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **If you are self-employed or have income without withholding,** the deductions may reduce your quarterly estimated payments. Do not reduce them too far, though, because underpayment penalties can apply.
segments.tr: - **자영업자이거나 원천징수되지 않는 소득이 있는 경우,** 공제로 인해 분기별 추정 납부액이 줄어들 수 있습니다. 다만, 과소납부 가산세가 부과될 수 있으므로 너무 많이 줄이지는 마세요.

segments.src: - **Be careful about guessing.** Cutting withholding too much because you expect a deduction can leave you owing money in the spring. That is a risk if you hit the income phase-out, change jobs, or work fewer overtime hours than you expected.
segments.tr: - **어림짐작은 주의하세요.** 공제를 예상하여 원천징수를 너무 많이 줄이면 봄에 세금을 납부해야 할 수 있습니다. 소득 단계적 축소 구간에 도달하거나, 이직하거나, 예상보다 초과 근무 시간이 줄어들 경우 이러한 위험이 발생합니다.

segments.src: A refund is not a bonus from the government.
segments.tr: 환급액은 정부에서 주는 보너스가 아닙니다.

segments.src: It is your own money returned after the year ends.
segments.tr: 연도가 끝난 후 돌려받는 본인의 돈입니다.

segments.src: Deciding between a big refund and a bigger paycheck is a personal budgeting choice.
segments.tr: 큰 환급액과 더 많은 급여 중 무엇을 선택할지는 개인의 예산 편성 선택입니다.

segments.src: ## Common Mistakes to Avoid
segments.tr: ## 피해야 할 흔한 실수

segments.src: - **Assuming every overtime dollar is deductible.** Only the premium portion of FLSA-required overtime counts.
segments.tr: - **모든 초과 근무 수당이 공제된다고 가정하는 것.** FLSA에서 요구하는 초과 근무의 프리미엄 부분만 인정됩니다.

segments.src: - **Forgetting the income limits.** Higher earners may get a reduced deduction or none.
segments.tr: - **소득 한도를 잊어버리는 것.** 고소득자는 공제액이 줄어들거나 공제를 받지 못할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Filing separately as a married couple.** This can disqualify you from some of these deductions.
segments.tr: - **기혼 부부가 따로 신고하는 것.** 이로 인해 일부 공제 자격을 상실할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Claiming unreported tips without records.** The IRS may ask you to show how you arrived at the number.
segments.tr: - **기록 없이 미신고 팁을 청구하는 것.** IRS에서 해당 금액이 산출된 과정을 증명하라고 요구할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Ignoring state taxes.** State rules differ. Some states follow the federal changes, while others do not.
segments.tr: - **주(State)세를 무시하는 것.** 주별 규정은 다릅니다. 일부 주는 연방 세법 변경 사항을 따르지만, 그렇지 않은 주도 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What to Do Next
segments.tr: ## 다음 단계

segments.src: 1. Check whether your job appears on the IRS tipped-occupation list, or whether your overtime is FLSA-required.
segments.tr: 1. 본인의 직업이 IRS 팁 직업 목록에 있는지, 또는 초과 근무가 FLSA 필수 항목인지 확인하세요.

segments.src: 2. Estimate your MAGI to see whether phase-outs could apply.
segments.tr: 2. MAGI를 추정하여 공제 축소 대상에 해당하는지 확인하세요.

segments.src: 3. Run the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator and decide whether to adjust your W-4.
segments.tr: 3. IRS 세금 원천징수 견적기를 실행하고 W-4를 조정할지 결정하세요.

segments.src: 4. Organize your records into one folder, paper or digital, before January.
segments.tr: 4. 1월이 되기 전에 종이든 디지털이든 기록을 하나의 폴더에 정리하세요.

segments.src: 5. When filing, use reputable tax software or a licensed preparer, and compare the results against the official IRS instructions.
segments.tr: 5. 신고할 때 평판이 좋은 세금 소프트웨어 또는 면허가 있는 세무 대행사를 이용하고, 공식 IRS 지침과 결과를 비교해 보세요.

segments.src: The new deductions can lower the tax bill for many workers and retirees, but they are not automatic and not unlimited.
segments.tr: 새로운 공제는 많은 근로자와 은퇴자의 세금 부담을 줄여줄 수 있지만, 자동이 아니며 무제한도 아닙니다.

segments.src: A little record-keeping in the coming weeks can make filing season go much more smoothly.

zh.title: 报税季前瞻：新的小费、加班费和老年人扣除额将如何影响您的2026年报税

segments.src: When filing season opens in early 2027, millions of taxpayers will meet several new lines on their returns.
segments.tr: 当2027年初报税季开始时，数百万纳税人将在其税表中看到几个新的项目。

segments.src: The 2025 federal tax law, known as the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, created temporary deductions for qualified tip income, qualified overtime pay and older adults.
segments.tr: 2025年的联邦税法，即《一个美好大账单法案》（One Big Beautiful Bill Act），为合格的小费收入、合格的加班费和老年人设立了临时扣除额。

segments.src: It also created one for interest on certain new auto loans.
segments.tr: 它还为某些新汽车贷款的利息设立了一项扣除额。

segments.src: Some workers filed with these items for tax year 2025.
segments.tr: 一些工人在申报2025纳税年度时已经使用了这些项目。

segments.src: For others, the 2026 return will be the first time they matter in a big way.
segments.tr: 对于其他人来说，2026年的税表将是这些项目首次产生重大影响的时候。

segments.src: The details are specific, and the rules are easy to misread.
segments.tr: 其中的细节非常具体，规则也很容易被误读。

segments.src: This guide explains who may qualify, what records are worth keeping now, and how paycheck withholding can change your refund.
segments.tr: 本指南解释了谁可能有资格申请、现在值得保留哪些记录，以及工资预扣税款如何改变您的退税额。

segments.src: *This article is general information, not tax advice.
segments.tr: *本文仅供参考，不构成税务建议。

segments.src: Rules, forms and IRS guidance can change, so check current IRS materials or talk to a qualified tax professional about your own situation.*
segments.tr: 规则、表格和国税局（IRS）的指导方针可能会发生变化，因此请查阅最新的IRS资料，或就您个人的情况咨询合格的税务专业人士。*

segments.src: ## The Big Picture: Deductions, Not Credits
segments.tr: ## 大局观：扣除额，而非抵免额

segments.src: These provisions are **deductions**, not credits.
segments.tr: 这些条款是**扣除额**（deductions），而不是抵免额（credits）。

segments.src: A deduction lowers the income your tax is calculated on.
segments.tr: 扣除额会降低计算税款的收入基数。

segments.src: A credit lowers the tax itself, dollar for dollar.
segments.tr: 抵免额则是直接等额减少税款本身。

segments.src: A $1,000 deduction therefore saves you roughly $100 to $370 in federal tax, depending on your tax bracket.
segments.tr: 因此，1,000美元的扣除额可以为您节省大约100美元到370美元的联邦税，具体取决于您的税率等级。

segments.src: It does not save you $1,000.
segments.tr: 它并不能为您节省1,000美元。

segments.src: Under the law, these deductions are generally available whether or not you itemize.
segments.tr: 根据法律，无论您是否逐项扣除，这些扣除额通常都是适用的。

segments.src: You can usually claim them on top of the standard deduction.
segments.tr: 您通常可以在标准扣除额之外申请这些扣除。

segments.src: They are scheduled to apply to tax years 2025 through 2028 unless Congress changes them.
segments.tr: 除非国会修改，否则这些扣除额计划适用于2025年至2028纳税年度。

segments.src: ## The Tips Deduction
segments.tr: ## 小费扣除额

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Workers who receive tips in an occupation that customarily and regularly received tips before 2025.
segments.tr: **谁可能有资格：** 在2025年之前习惯且经常收到小费的职业中获得小费的工人。

segments.src: The Treasury Department published a list of qualifying occupations.
segments.tr: 财政部发布了一份合格职业清单。

segments.src: It includes jobs such as servers, bartenders, hotel workers, hair and beauty professionals, and delivery drivers.
segments.tr: 其中包括服务员、调酒师、酒店工作人员、美发和美容专业人士以及送货司机等工作。

segments.src: Check the current list for your job.
segments.tr: 请查看当前的职业清单以确认您的工作是否在列。

segments.src: **Key points:**
- The deduction is capped at **$25,000** per return for qualified tips.
segments.tr: - 合格小费的扣除额上限为每份税表 **$25,000**。

segments.src: - The tips must be voluntary. A mandatory service charge added to a bill generally does not count.
segments.tr: - 小费必须是自愿给付的。账单中添加的强制性服务费通常不计入在内。

segments.src: - The deduction begins to phase out when modified adjusted gross income (MAGI) exceeds roughly **$150,000** for single filers and **$300,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - 当调整后总收入（MAGI）超过单身申报者约 **$150,000** 和联合申报者 **$300,000** 时，扣除额开始逐步递减。

segments.src: - Self-employed people may qualify in some cases, but the deduction cannot exceed the net income from the business that earned the tips. Certain specified service trades or businesses are excluded.
segments.tr: - 自雇人士在某些情况下可能有资格，但扣除额不能超过赚取小费的业务的净收入。某些特定的服务行业或企业被排除在外。

segments.src: - Married couples generally must file jointly to claim it, and a valid Social Security number is required.
segments.tr: - 已婚夫妇通常必须联合申报才能申请，并且需要有效的社会安全号码。

segments.src: - This deduction applies to federal income tax. Social Security and Medicare payroll taxes still apply to tips.
segments.tr: - 此扣除额适用于联邦所得税。社会安全税和医疗保险工资税仍然适用于小费。

segments.src: ## The Overtime Deduction
segments.tr: ## 加班费扣除额

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Employees who are paid overtime required under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).
segments.tr: **谁可能有资格：** 根据《公平劳动标准法》（FLSA）获得加班费的雇员。

segments.src: **Key points:**
- Only the "premium" portion of overtime counts. If you earn time-and-a-half, the deduction covers the extra half, not the full hourly rate for those hours.
segments.tr: - 只有加班费中的“溢价”部分才计入。如果您赚取的是1.5倍工资，扣除额涵盖的是额外的0.5倍部分，而不是这些小时的全额时薪。

segments.src: - The maximum deduction is **$12,500** for single filers and **$25,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - 单身申报者的最高扣除额为 **$12,500**，联合申报者为 **$25,000**。

segments.src: - The same MAGI phase-out thresholds apply as for tips (roughly $150,000 single, $300,000 joint).
segments.tr: - 适用与小费相同的MAGI逐步递减门槛（单身约$150,000，联合申报约$300,000）。

segments.src: - Overtime paid under a union contract or company policy that goes beyond what the FLSA requires may not qualify.
segments.tr: - 根据工会合同或公司政策支付的、超出FLSA要求部分的加班费可能不符合条件。

segments.src: - A valid Social Security number is required, and married couples generally must file jointly.
segments.tr: - 需要有效的社会安全号码，且已婚夫妇通常必须联合申报。

segments.src: ## The Senior Deduction
segments.tr: ## 老年人扣除额

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Taxpayers who are age 65 or older by the end of the tax year.
segments.tr: **谁可能有资格：** 在纳税年度结束时年满65岁或以上的纳税人。

segments.src: **Key points:**
- The additional deduction is **$6,000 per eligible person**. A married couple where both spouses are 65 or older could claim up to $12,000.
segments.tr: - 额外扣除额为 **每位符合条件的人 $6,000**。如果夫妻双方均年满65岁或以上，最高可申请$12,000的扣除额。

segments.src: - It phases out at a rate of 6 cents per dollar of MAGI above about **$75,000** for single filers and **$150,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - 当MAGI超过单身申报者约 **$75,000** 和联合申报者 **$150,000** 时，扣除额将以每1美元MAGI递减6美分的比例逐步减少。

segments.src: - It is separate from the existing additional standard deduction for people 65 and older, so the two can stack.
segments.tr: - 这与现有的针对65岁及以上人群的额外标准扣除额是分开的，因此两者可以叠加。

segments.src: - You must include a valid Social Security number for each person claimed.
segments.tr: - 您必须为每位申请人提供有效的社会安全号码。

segments.src: ## Auto Loan Interest, Briefly
segments.tr: ## 简述汽车贷款利息

segments.src: A related deduction covers up to **$10,000** of interest a year on a loan for a qualifying new vehicle.
segments.tr: 一项相关的扣除额涵盖了符合条件的新车贷款每年最高 **$10,000** 的利息。

segments.src: The vehicle must have final assembly in the United States, and the loan must have been taken out after 2024.
segments.tr: 该车辆必须在美国进行最终组装，且贷款必须是在2024年之后获得的。

segments.src: Income limits apply.
segments.tr: 有收入限制。

segments.src: If you bought a car recently, keep your loan statements.
segments.tr: 如果您最近买了车，请保留您的贷款对账单。

segments.src: ## Records to Keep Now
segments.tr: ## 现在需要保留的记录

segments.src: The best way to claim these deductions is to document your income as you earn it.
segments.tr: 申请这些扣除额的最佳方式是在赚取收入时就记录下来。

segments.src: Consider these steps before the year ends:
segments.tr: 在年底前考虑采取以下步骤：

segments.src: 1. **Tipped workers:** Keep a daily log of cash tips, plus card and app tips. Save statements from your employer's payroll or point-of-sale system. If you work through a delivery or rideshare platform, download your year-end earnings summaries.
segments.tr: 1. **收小费的工人：** 每日记录现金小费，以及银行卡和应用程序小费。保存雇主工资单或销售点系统的对账单。如果您通过送货或拼车平台工作，请下载您的年终收入汇总。

segments.src: 2. **Overtime earners:** Keep your pay stubs. Make sure you can see regular hours, overtime hours and the overtime rate. Ask your payroll department how overtime is labeled.
segments.tr: 2. **加班费获得者：** 保留您的工资单。确保您能看到正常工时、加班工时和加班费率。询问您的工资部门加班费是如何标记的。

segments.src: 3. **Older adults:** Confirm your date of birth and Social Security number on all your tax records. If you are married, confirm the same for your spouse.
segments.tr: 3. **老年人：** 在您所有的税务记录上确认您的出生日期和社会安全号码。如果您已婚，请为您的配偶确认相同信息。

segments.src: 4. **Car buyers:** Save the loan agreement, the vehicle identification number (VIN) and interest statements.
segments.tr: 4. **购车者：** 保存贷款协议、车辆识别码（VIN）和利息对账单。

segments.src: 5. **Everyone:** Look at your last pay stub of the year and compare it with the W-2 you receive in January. The IRS has been working with employers on new reporting. Expect separate reporting for qualified tips and overtime, but not every employer will have fully adapted. If your W-2 does not break out these amounts, you may need your own records to support the deduction.
segments.tr: 5. **所有人：** 查看您年底最后一张工资单，并将其与您在一月份收到的W-2表格进行比较。IRS一直在与雇主合作进行新的报告。预计会有针对合格小费和加班费的单独报告，但并非每位雇主都会完全适应。如果您的W-2没有列出这些金额，您可能需要自己的记录来支持扣除额。

segments.src: ## How Withholding Could Affect Your Refund
segments.tr: ## 预扣税款如何影响您的退税

segments.src: Your refund is simply the difference between what was withheld from your pay during the year and what you actually owe.
segments.tr: 您的退税额仅仅是您全年从工资中预扣的税款与您实际应缴税款之间的差额。

segments.src: These new deductions reduce what you owe.
segments.tr: 这些新的扣除额减少了您的应缴税款。

segments.src: They do not automatically reduce what your employer withholds, unless you or your employer adjusts it.
segments.tr: 除非您或您的雇主进行调整，否则它们不会自动减少雇主预扣的税款。

segments.src: - **If your withholding did not change,** you may be overpaying during the year and get a **larger refund** after you claim the deductions.
segments.tr: - **如果您的预扣税款没有改变，** 您可能在全年多缴了税，并在申请扣除额后获得 **更多的退税**。

segments.src: - **If you want more take-home pay now,** you can submit a new Form W-4 to your employer, using the deductions worksheet to account for the new deductions. The IRS Tax Withholding Estimator at IRS.gov can help you pick sensible numbers.
segments.tr: - **如果您现在想要更多的实得工资，** 您可以向雇主提交一份新的W-4表格，使用扣除额工作表来计算这些新的扣除额。IRS.gov上的“IRS税务预扣估算器”（Tax Withholding Estimator）可以帮助您选择合理的数字。

segments.src: - **If you are self-employed or have income without withholding,** the deductions may reduce your quarterly estimated payments. Do not reduce them too far, though, because underpayment penalties can apply.
segments.tr: - **如果您是自雇人士或有无需预扣的收入，** 这些扣除额可能会减少您的季度预估税款。不过，不要减少得太多，因为可能会产生少缴税款的罚款。

segments.src: - **Be careful about guessing.** Cutting withholding too much because you expect a deduction can leave you owing money in the spring. That is a risk if you hit the income phase-out, change jobs, or work fewer overtime hours than you expected.
segments.tr: - **小心猜测。** 因为预期有扣除额而过度削减预扣税款可能会导致您在春季反而欠税。如果您达到了收入递减门槛、换了工作，或者加班时间少于预期，这都是一种风险。

segments.src: A refund is not a bonus from the government.
segments.tr: 退税不是政府给的奖金。

segments.src: It is your own money returned after the year ends.
segments.tr: 这是您自己的钱，在年底后退还给您。

segments.src: Deciding between a big refund and a bigger paycheck is a personal budgeting choice.
segments.tr: 在巨额退税和更高的工资之间做决定是一个个人的预算选择。

segments.src: ## Common Mistakes to Avoid
segments.tr: ## 应避免的常见错误

segments.src: - **Assuming every overtime dollar is deductible.** Only the premium portion of FLSA-required overtime counts.
segments.tr: - **假设每一美元的加班费都可以扣除。** 只有FLSA要求的加班费中的溢价部分才计入。

segments.src: - **Forgetting the income limits.** Higher earners may get a reduced deduction or none.
segments.tr: - **忘记收入限制。** 高收入者可能会获得减少的扣除额或根本无法获得扣除。

segments.src: - **Filing separately as a married couple.** This can disqualify you from some of these deductions.
segments.tr: - **已婚夫妇分开申报。** 这可能会使您失去申请其中一些扣除额的资格。

segments.src: - **Claiming unreported tips without records.** The IRS may ask you to show how you arrived at the number.
segments.tr: - **在没有记录的情况下申报未报告的小费。** IRS可能会要求您出示得出该数字的依据。

segments.src: - **Ignoring state taxes.** State rules differ. Some states follow the federal changes, while others do not.
segments.tr: - **忽视州税。** 各州的规则不同。有些州遵循联邦的变更，而另一些则不遵循。

segments.src: ## What to Do Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来要做什么

segments.src: 1. Check whether your job appears on the IRS tipped-occupation list, or whether your overtime is FLSA-required.
segments.tr: 1. 检查您的工作是否出现在IRS的小费职业清单上，或者您的加班费是否属于FLSA要求的加班费。

segments.src: 2. Estimate your MAGI to see whether phase-outs could apply.
segments.tr: 2. 估算您的MAGI，看看是否适用逐步递减规则。

segments.src: 3. Run the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator and decide whether to adjust your W-4.
segments.tr: 3. 运行IRS税务预扣估算器，并决定是否调整您的W-4表格。

segments.src: 4. Organize your records into one folder, paper or digital, before January.
segments.tr: 4. 在一月份之前，将您的记录整理到一个文件夹中，无论是纸质还是数字版。

segments.src: 5. When filing, use reputable tax software or a licensed preparer, and compare the results against the official IRS instructions.
segments.tr: 5. 报税时，使用信誉良好的税务软件或持牌税务准备人员，并将结果与官方IRS说明进行比较。

segments.src: The new deductions can lower the tax bill for many workers and retirees, but they are not automatic and not unlimited.
segments.tr: 新的扣除额可以降低许多工人和退休人员的税单，但它们不是自动生效的，也不是无限的。

segments.src: A little record-keeping in the coming weeks can make filing season go much more smoothly.
segments.tr: 在接下来的几周里做一点记录工作，可以让报税季进行得更加顺利。

segments.tr: 本内容仅供一般参考，不构成法律、税务或财务建议。*

segments.src: ## The Tips Deduction

segments.src: 2. **Overtime earners:** Keep your pay stubs. Make sure you can see regular hours, overtime hours and the overtime rate. Ask your payroll department how overtime is labeled.
segments.tr: 2. **Personas que ganan horas extras:** Conserve sus recibos de pago. Asegúrese de poder ver las horas regulares, las horas extras y la tarifa de horas extras. Pregunte al departamento de nómina cómo se etiquetan las horas extras.

segments.src: 3. **Older adults:** Confirm your date of birth and Social Security number on all your tax records. If you are married, confirm the same for your spouse.
segments.tr: 3. **Adultos mayores:** Confirme su fecha de nacimiento y número de Seguro Social en todos sus registros fiscales. Si está casado, confirme lo mismo para su cónyuge.

segments.src: 4. **Car buyers:** Save the loan agreement, the vehicle identification number (VIN) and interest statements.
segments.tr: 4. **Compradores de automóviles:** Guarde el contrato de préstamo, el número de identificación del vehículo (VIN) y los estados de cuenta de intereses.

segments.src: 5. **Everyone:** Look at your last pay stub of the year and compare it with the W-2 you receive in January. The IRS has been working with employers on new reporting. Expect separate reporting for qualified tips and overtime, but not every employer will have fully adapted. If your W-2 does not break out these amounts, you may need your own records to support the deduction.
segments.tr: 5. **Todos:** Revise su último recibo de pago del año y compárelo con el formulario W-2 que recibe en enero. El IRS ha estado trabajando con los empleadores en nuevos informes. Espere informes separados para las propinas y horas extras calificadas, aunque no todos los empleadores se habrán adaptado por completo. Si su formulario W-2 no desglosa estas cantidades, es posible que necesite sus propios registros para respaldar la deducción.

segments.src: ## How Withholding Could Affect Your Refund
segments.tr: ## Cómo la retención podría afectar su reembolso

segments.src: Your refund is simply the difference between what was withheld from your pay during the year and what you actually owe.
segments.tr: Su reembolso es simplemente la diferencia entre lo que se retuvo de su pago durante el año y lo que realmente debe.

segments.src: These new deductions reduce what you owe.
segments.tr: Estas nuevas deducciones reducen lo que debe.

segments.src: They do not automatically reduce what your employer withholds, unless you or your employer adjusts it.
segments.tr: No reducen automáticamente lo que su empleador retiene, a menos que usted o su empleador lo ajusten.

segments.src: - **If your withholding did not change,** you may be overpaying during the year and get a **larger refund** after you claim the deductions.
segments.tr: - **Si su retención no cambió,** es posible que esté pagando de más durante el año y obtenga un **reembolso mayor** después de reclamar las deducciones.

segments.src: - **If you want more take-home pay now,** you can submit a new Form W-4 to your employer, using the deductions worksheet to account for the new deductions. The IRS Tax Withholding Estimator at IRS.gov can help you pick sensible numbers.
segments.tr: - **Si desea tener más dinero disponible ahora,** puede presentar un nuevo Formulario W-4 a su empleador, utilizando la hoja de trabajo de deducciones para tener en cuenta las nuevas deducciones. El Estimador de Retención de Impuestos del IRS en IRS.gov puede ayudarle a elegir cifras sensatas.

segments.src: - **If you are self-employed or have income without withholding,** the deductions may reduce your quarterly estimated payments. Do not reduce them too far, though, because underpayment penalties can apply.
segments.tr: - **Si trabaja por cuenta propia o tiene ingresos sin retención,** las deducciones pueden reducir sus pagos estimados trimestrales. Sin embargo, no los reduzca demasiado, ya que se pueden aplicar multas por pago insuficiente.

segments.src: - **Be careful about guessing.** Cutting withholding too much because you expect a deduction can leave you owing money in the spring. That is a risk if you hit the income phase-out, change jobs, or work fewer overtime hours than you expected.
segments.tr: - **Tenga cuidado al adivinar.** Reducir demasiado la retención porque espera una deducción puede hacer que deba dinero en la primavera. Eso es un riesgo si supera el límite de ingresos, cambia de trabajo o trabaja menos horas extras de las que esperaba.

segments.src: A refund is not a bonus from the government.
segments.tr: Un reembolso no es un bono del gobierno.

segments.src: It is your own money returned after the year ends.
segments.tr: Es su propio dinero devuelto después de que termina el año.

segments.src: Deciding between a big refund and a bigger paycheck is a personal budgeting choice.
segments.tr: Decidir entre un reembolso grande y un cheque de pago mayor es una opción de presupuesto personal.

segments.src: ## Common Mistakes to Avoid
segments.tr: ## Errores comunes que debe evitar

segments.src: - **Assuming every overtime dollar is deductible.** Only the premium portion of FLSA-required overtime counts.
segments.tr: - **Asumir que cada dólar de horas extras es deducible.** Solo cuenta la porción de prima de las horas extras requeridas por la FLSA.

segments.src: - **Forgetting the income limits.** Higher earners may get a reduced deduction or none.
segments.tr: - **Olvidar los límites de ingresos.** Los contribuyentes con mayores ingresos pueden recibir una deducción reducida o ninguna.

segments.src: - **Filing separately as a married couple.** This can disqualify you from some of these deductions.
segments.tr: - **Presentar declaraciones por separado como pareja casada.** Esto puede descalificarle para algunas de estas deducciones.

segments.src: - **Claiming unreported tips without records.** The IRS may ask you to show how you arrived at the number.
segments.tr: - **Reclamar propinas no declaradas sin registros.** El IRS puede pedirle que muestre cómo llegó a esa cifra.

segments.src: - **Ignoring state taxes.** State rules differ. Some states follow the federal changes, while others do not.
segments.tr: - **Ignorar los impuestos estatales.** Las reglas estatales varían. Algunos estados siguen los cambios federales, mientras que otros no.

segments.src: ## What to Do Next
segments.tr: ## Qué hacer a continuación

segments.src: 1. Check whether your job appears on the IRS tipped-occupation list, or whether your overtime is FLSA-required.
segments.tr: 1. Verifique si su trabajo aparece en la lista de ocupaciones con propinas del IRS, o si sus horas extras son requeridas por la FLSA.

segments.src: 2. Estimate your MAGI to see whether phase-outs could apply.
segments.tr: 2. Estime su MAGI para ver si se podrían aplicar las eliminaciones graduales.

segments.src: 3. Run the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator and decide whether to adjust your W-4.
segments.tr: 3. Ejecute el Estimador de Retención de Impuestos del IRS y decida si debe ajustar su formulario W-4.

segments.src: 4. Organize your records into one folder, paper or digital, before January.
segments.tr: 4. Organice sus registros en una carpeta, en papel o digital, antes de enero.

segments.src: 5. When filing, use reputable tax software or a licensed preparer, and compare the results against the official IRS instructions.
segments.tr: 5. Al presentar su declaración, utilice un software fiscal confiable o un preparador autorizado, y compare los resultados con las instrucciones oficiales del IRS.

segments.src: The new deductions can lower the tax bill for many workers and retirees, but they are not automatic and not unlimited.
segments.tr: Las nuevas deducciones pueden reducir la factura de impuestos de muchos trabajadores y jubilados, pero no son automáticas ni ilimitadas.

segments.src: A little record-keeping in the coming weeks can make filing season go much more smoothly.
segments.tr: Un poco de mantenimiento de registros en las próximas semanas puede hacer que la temporada de declaraciones sea mucho más fluida.

segments.tr: *Fuentes a consultar: Orientación de IRS.gov sobre la Ley del Gran y Hermoso Proyecto de Ley, las instrucciones del Formulario W-4 y el Estimador de Retención de Impuestos.

segments.src: When filing season opens in early 2027, millions of taxpayers will meet several new lines on their returns.
segments.tr: عندما يبدأ موسم تقديم الإقرارات الضريبية في أوائل عام 2027، سيواجه ملايين دافعي الضرائب عدة بنود جديدة في إقراراتهم.

segments.src: The 2025 federal tax law, known as the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, created temporary deductions for qualified tip income, qualified overtime pay and older adults.
segments.tr: أنشأ قانون الضرائب الفيدرالي لعام 2025، المعروف باسم قانون "One Big Beautiful Bill Act"، خصومات مؤقتة لدخل الإكراميات المؤهل، وأجر العمل الإضافي المؤهل، وكبار السن.

segments.src: It also created one for interest on certain new auto loans.
segments.tr: كما أنشأ خصماً للفائدة على بعض قروض السيارات الجديدة.

segments.src: Some workers filed with these items for tax year 2025.
segments.tr: قدم بعض العمال إقراراتهم بهذه البنود للسنة الضريبية 2025.

segments.src: For others, the 2026 return will be the first time they matter in a big way.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للآخرين، سيكون إقرار عام 2026 هو المرة الأولى التي يكون لهذه البنود فيها أهمية كبيرة.

segments.src: The details are specific, and the rules are easy to misread.
segments.tr: التفاصيل محددة، والقواعد سهلة الفهم بشكل خاطئ.

segments.src: This guide explains who may qualify, what records are worth keeping now, and how paycheck withholding can change your refund.
segments.tr: يشرح هذا الدليل من قد يكون مؤهلاً، وما هي السجلات التي تستحق الاحتفاظ بها الآن، وكيف يمكن لاقتطاع الضرائب من الراتب أن يغير استردادك الضريبي.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not tax advice.
segments.tr: *هذه المقالة هي معلومات عامة، وليست نصيحة ضريبية.

segments.src: Rules, forms and IRS guidance can change, so check current IRS materials or talk to a qualified tax professional about your own situation.*
segments.tr: القواعد والنماذج وتوجيهات مصلحة الضرائب (IRS) يمكن أن تتغير، لذا تحقق من مواد مصلحة الضرائب الحالية أو تحدث إلى متخصص ضرائب مؤهل حول وضعك الخاص.*

segments.src: ## The Big Picture: Deductions, Not Credits
segments.tr: ## الصورة الكبيرة: خصومات، وليست ائتمانات

segments.src: These provisions are **deductions**, not credits.
segments.tr: هذه الأحكام هي **خصومات**، وليست ائتمانات.

segments.src: A deduction lowers the income your tax is calculated on.
segments.tr: الخصم يقلل الدخل الذي تُحسب عليه ضريبتك.

segments.src: A credit lowers the tax itself, dollar for dollar.
segments.tr: الائتمان يقلل الضريبة نفسها، دولاراً مقابل دولار.

segments.src: A $1,000 deduction therefore saves you roughly $100 to $370 in federal tax, depending on your tax bracket.
segments.tr: لذلك، فإن خصماً بقيمة 1,000 دولار يوفر لك ما يقرب من 100 إلى 370 دولاراً من الضريبة الفيدرالية، اعتماداً على شريحتك الضريبية.

segments.src: It does not save you $1,000.
segments.tr: إنه لا يوفر لك 1,000 دولار.

segments.src: Under the law, these deductions are generally available whether or not you itemize.
segments.tr: بموجب القانون، تتوفر هذه الخصومات عموماً سواء قمت بتفصيل الخصومات أم لا.

segments.src: You can usually claim them on top of the standard deduction.
segments.tr: يمكنك عادةً المطالبة بها بالإضافة إلى الخصم القياسي.

segments.src: They are scheduled to apply to tax years 2025 through 2028 unless Congress changes them.
segments.tr: من المقرر أن تنطبق على السنوات الضريبية من 2025 إلى 2028 ما لم يغيرها الكونغرس.

segments.src: ## The Tips Deduction
segments.tr: ## خصم الإكراميات

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Workers who receive tips in an occupation that customarily and regularly received tips before 2025.
segments.tr: **من قد يكون مؤهلاً:** العمال الذين يتلقون إكراميات في مهنة كانت تتلقى إكراميات بشكل معتاد ومنتظم قبل عام 2025.

segments.src: The Treasury Department published a list of qualifying occupations.
segments.tr: نشرت وزارة الخزانة قائمة بالمهن المؤهلة.

segments.src: It includes jobs such as servers, bartenders, hotel workers, hair and beauty professionals, and delivery drivers.
segments.tr: وهي تشمل وظائف مثل النوادل، وسقاة الحانات، وعمال الفنادق، ومحترفي الشعر والتجميل، وسائقي التوصيل.

segments.src: Check the current list for your job.
segments.tr: تحقق من القائمة الحالية لوظيفتك.

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **نقاط رئيسية:**

segments.src: - The deduction is capped at **$25,000** per return for qualified tips.
segments.tr: - الخصم بحد أقصى **25,000 دولار** لكل إقرار للإكراميات المؤهلة.

segments.src: - The tips must be voluntary. A mandatory service charge added to a bill generally does not count.
segments.tr: - يجب أن تكون الإكراميات طوعية. رسوم الخدمة الإلزامية المضافة إلى الفاتورة لا تُحتسب عموماً.

segments.src: - The deduction begins to phase out when modified adjusted gross income (MAGI) exceeds roughly **$150,000** for single filers and **$300,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - يبدأ الخصم في التلاشي تدريجياً عندما يتجاوز الدخل الإجمالي المعدل المعدل (MAGI) حوالي **150,000 دولار** للمقدمين الأفراد و **300,000 دولار** للمقدمين المشتركين.

segments.src: - Self-employed people may qualify in some cases, but the deduction cannot exceed the net income from the business that earned the tips. Certain specified service trades or businesses are excluded.
segments.tr: - قد يكون العاملون لحسابهم الخاص مؤهلين في بعض الحالات، ولكن لا يمكن أن يتجاوز الخصم صافي الدخل من العمل الذي كسب الإكراميات. بعض المهن أو الأعمال الخدمية المحددة مستثناة.

segments.src: - Married couples generally must file jointly to claim it, and a valid Social Security number is required.
segments.tr: - يجب على الأزواج عموماً تقديم إقرار مشترك للمطالبة به، ويلزم وجود رقم ضمان اجتماعي صالح.

segments.src: - This deduction applies to federal income tax. Social Security and Medicare payroll taxes still apply to tips.
segments.tr: - ينطبق هذا الخصم على ضريبة الدخل الفيدرالية. لا تزال ضرائب الرواتب للضمان الاجتماعي والرعاية الطبية (Medicare) تنطبق على الإكراميات.

segments.src: ## The Overtime Deduction
segments.tr: ## خصم العمل الإضافي

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Employees who are paid overtime required under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).
segments.tr: **من قد يكون مؤهلاً:** الموظفون الذين يتقاضون أجراً عن العمل الإضافي المطلوب بموجب قانون معايير العمل العادلة (FLSA).

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **نقاط رئيسية:**

segments.src: - Only the "premium" portion of overtime counts. If you earn time-and-a-half, the deduction covers the extra half, not the full hourly rate for those hours.
segments.tr: - فقط الجزء "الإضافي" (premium) من العمل الإضافي هو الذي يُحتسب. إذا كنت تكسب أجر ساعة ونصف، فإن الخصم يغطي النصف الإضافي، وليس كامل معدل الساعة لتلك الساعات.

segments.src: - The maximum deduction is **$12,500** for single filers and **$25,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - الحد الأقصى للخصم هو **12,500 دولار** للمقدمين الأفراد و **25,000 دولار** للمقدمين المشتركين.

segments.src: - The same MAGI phase-out thresholds apply as for tips (roughly $150,000 single, $300,000 joint).
segments.tr: - تنطبق نفس عتبات تلاشي الدخل الإجمالي المعدل (MAGI) كما هو الحال بالنسبة للإكراميات (حوالي 150,000 دولار للأفراد، 300,000 دولار للمشتركين).

segments.src: - Overtime paid under a union contract or company policy that goes beyond what the FLSA requires may not qualify.
segments.tr: - العمل الإضافي المدفوع بموجب عقد نقابي أو سياسة شركة تتجاوز ما يتطلبه قانون معايير العمل العادلة (FLSA) قد لا يكون مؤهلاً.

segments.src: - A valid Social Security number is required, and married couples generally must file jointly.
segments.tr: - يلزم وجود رقم ضمان اجتماعي صالح، ويجب على الأزواج عموماً تقديم إقرار مشترك.

segments.src: ## The Senior Deduction
segments.tr: ## خصم كبار السن

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Taxpayers who are age 65 or older by the end of the tax year.
segments.tr: **من قد يكون مؤهلاً:** دافعو الضرائب الذين تبلغ أعمارهم 65 عاماً أو أكثر بحلول نهاية السنة الضريبية.

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **نقاط رئيسية:**

segments.src: - The additional deduction is **$6,000 per eligible person**. A married couple where both spouses are 65 or older could claim up to $12,000.
segments.tr: - الخصم الإضافي هو **6,000 دولار لكل شخص مؤهل**. يمكن للزوجين اللذين يبلغ كلاهما 65 عاماً أو أكثر المطالبة بما يصل إلى 12,000 دولار.

segments.src: - It phases out at a rate of 6 cents per dollar of MAGI above about **$75,000** for single filers and **$150,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - يتلاشى الخصم بمعدل 6 سنتات لكل دولار من الدخل الإجمالي المعدل (MAGI) فوق حوالي **75,000 دولار** للمقدمين الأفراد و **150,000 دولار** للمقدمين المشتركين.

segments.src: - It is separate from the existing additional standard deduction for people 65 and older, so the two can stack.
segments.tr: - إنه منفصل عن الخصم القياسي الإضافي الحالي للأشخاص الذين تبلغ أعمارهم 65 عاماً فأكثر، لذا يمكن جمع الاثنين معاً.

segments.src: - You must include a valid Social Security number for each person claimed.
segments.tr: - يجب عليك تضمين رقم ضمان اجتماعي صالح لكل شخص يتم المطالبة به.

segments.src: ## Auto Loan Interest, Briefly
segments.tr: ## فائدة قرض السيارة، باختصار

segments.src: A related deduction covers up to **$10,000** of interest a year on a loan for a qualifying new vehicle.
segments.tr: يغطي خصم ذو صلة ما يصل إلى **10,000 دولار** من الفائدة سنوياً على قرض لسيارة جديدة مؤهلة.

segments.src: The vehicle must have final assembly in the United States, and the loan must have been taken out after 2024.
segments.tr: يجب أن تكون السيارة قد تم تجميعها نهائياً في الولايات المتحدة، ويجب أن يكون القرض قد تم الحصول عليه بعد عام 2024.

segments.src: Income limits apply.
segments.tr: تنطبق حدود الدخل.

segments.src: If you bought a car recently, keep your loan statements.
segments.tr: إذا اشتريت سيارة مؤخراً، احتفظ بكشوفات القرض الخاصة بك.

segments.src: ## Records to Keep Now
segments.tr: ## السجلات التي يجب الاحتفاظ بها الآن

segments.src: The best way to claim these deductions is to document your income as you earn it.
segments.tr: أفضل طريقة للمطالبة بهذه الخصومات هي توثيق دخلك أثناء كسبه.

segments.src: Consider these steps before the year ends:
segments.tr: فكر في هذه الخطوات قبل نهاية العام:

segments.src: 1. **Tipped workers:** Keep a daily log of cash tips, plus card and app tips. Save statements from your employer's payroll or point-of-sale system. If you work through a delivery or rideshare platform, download your year-end earnings summaries.
segments.tr: 1. **العمال الذين يتلقون إكراميات:** احتفظ بسجل يومي لإكراميات النقد، بالإضافة إلى إكراميات البطاقات والتطبيقات. احفظ كشوفات الرواتب من صاحب العمل أو نظام نقاط البيع. إذا كنت تعمل من خلال منصة توصيل أو مشاركة رحلات، قم بتنزيل ملخصات أرباحك لنهاية العام.

segments.src: 2. **Overtime earners:** Keep your pay stubs. Make sure you can see regular hours, overtime hours and the overtime rate. Ask your payroll department how overtime is labeled.
segments.tr: 2. **أصحاب العمل الإضافي:** احتفظ بقسائم راتبك. تأكد من أنه يمكنك رؤية الساعات العادية، وساعات العمل الإضافي، ومعدل العمل الإضافي. اسأل قسم الرواتب لديك عن كيفية تصنيف العمل الإضافي.

segments.src: 3. **Older adults:** Confirm your date of birth and Social Security number on all your tax records. If you are married, confirm the same for your spouse.
segments.tr: 3. **كبار السن:** أكد تاريخ ميلادك ورقم الضمان الاجتماعي في جميع سجلاتك الضريبية. إذا كنت متزوجاً، أكد نفس الشيء لزوجك/زوجتك.

segments.src: 4. **Car buyers:** Save the loan agreement, the vehicle identification number (VIN) and interest statements.
segments.tr: 4. **مشترو السيارات:** احفظ اتفاقية القرض، ورقم تعريف السيارة (VIN)، وكشوفات الفائدة.

segments.src: 5. **Everyone:** Look at your last pay stub of the year and compare it with the W-2 you receive in January. The IRS has been working with employers on new reporting. Expect separate reporting for qualified tips and overtime, but not every employer will have fully adapted. If your W-2 does not break out these amounts, you may need your own records to support the deduction.
segments.tr: 5. **الجميع:** انظر إلى آخر قسيمة راتب لك في العام وقارنها بنموذج W-2 الذي تتلقاه في يناير. تعمل مصلحة الضرائب (IRS) مع أصحاب العمل على إعداد تقارير جديدة. توقع تقارير منفصلة للإكراميات المؤهلة والعمل الإضافي، ولكن لن يتكيف كل صاحب عمل بالكامل. إذا كان نموذج W-2 الخاص بك لا يفصل هذه المبالغ، فقد تحتاج إلى سجلاتك الخاصة لدعم الخصم.

segments.src: ## How Withholding Could Affect Your Refund
segments.tr: ## كيف يمكن أن يؤثر الاقتطاع على استردادك الضريبي

segments.src: Your refund is simply the difference between what was withheld from your pay during the year and what you actually owe.
segments.tr: استردادك الضريبي هو ببساطة الفرق بين ما تم اقتطاعه من راتبك خلال العام وما تدين به فعلياً.

segments.src: These new deductions reduce what you owe.
segments.tr: هذه الخصومات الجديدة تقلل مما تدين به.

segments.src: They do not automatically reduce what your employer withholds, unless you or your employer adjusts it.
segments.tr: إنها لا تقلل تلقائياً ما يقتطعه صاحب العمل، ما لم تقم أنت أو صاحب العمل بتعديله.

segments.src: - **If your withholding did not change,** you may be overpaying during the year and get a **larger refund** after you claim the deductions.
segments.tr: - **إذا لم يتغير اقتطاعك،** فقد تكون تدفع أكثر من اللازم خلال العام وتحصل على **استرداد أكبر** بعد المطالبة بالخصومات.

segments.src: - **If you want more take-home pay now,** you can submit a new Form W-4 to your employer, using the deductions worksheet to account for the new deductions. The IRS Tax Withholding Estimator at IRS.gov can help you pick sensible numbers.
segments.tr: - **إذا كنت تريد المزيد من صافي الراتب الآن،** يمكنك تقديم نموذج W-4 جديد لصاحب العمل، باستخدام ورقة عمل الخصومات لحساب الخصومات الجديدة. يمكن أن يساعدك "مقدر اقتطاع الضرائب" (Tax Withholding Estimator) التابع لمصلحة الضرائب على IRS.gov في اختيار أرقام معقولة.

segments.src: - **If you are self-employed or have income without withholding,** the deductions may reduce your quarterly estimated payments. Do not reduce them too far, though, because underpayment penalties can apply.
segments.tr: - **إذا كنت تعمل لحسابك الخاص أو لديك دخل بدون اقتطاع،** قد تقلل الخصومات من مدفوعاتك التقديرية ربع السنوية. لا تقللها كثيراً، لأن عقوبات الدفع الناقص يمكن أن تنطبق.

segments.src: - **Be careful about guessing.** Cutting withholding too much because you expect a deduction can leave you owing money in the spring. That is a risk if you hit the income phase-out, change jobs, or work fewer overtime hours than you expected.
segments.tr: - **كن حذراً بشأن التخمين.** تقليل الاقتطاع كثيراً لأنك تتوقع خصماً قد يتركك مديناً بالمال في الربيع. هذا خطر إذا وصلت إلى مرحلة تلاشي الدخل، أو غيرت وظيفتك، أو عملت ساعات عمل إضافي أقل مما كنت تتوقع.

segments.src: A refund is not a bonus from the government.
segments.tr: الاسترداد الضريبي ليس مكافأة من الحكومة.

segments.src: It is your own money returned after the year ends.
segments.tr: إنه مالك الخاص الذي يعود إليك بعد انتهاء العام.

segments.src: Deciding between a big refund and a bigger paycheck is a personal budgeting choice.
segments.tr: اتخاذ القرار بين استرداد كبير وراتب أكبر هو خيار ميزانية شخصي.

segments.src: ## Common Mistakes to Avoid
segments.tr: ## أخطاء شائعة يجب تجنبها

segments.src: - **Assuming every overtime dollar is deductible.** Only the premium portion of FLSA-required overtime counts.
segments.tr: - **افتراض أن كل دولار عمل إضافي قابل للخصم.** فقط الجزء الإضافي من العمل الإضافي المطلوب بموجب قانون معايير العمل العادلة (FLSA) هو الذي يُحتسب.

segments.src: - **Forgetting the income limits.** Higher earners may get a reduced deduction or none.
segments.tr: - **نسيان حدود الدخل.** قد يحصل أصحاب الدخل الأعلى على خصم مخفض أو لا يحصلون على أي خصم.

segments.src: - **Filing separately as a married couple.** This can disqualify you from some of these deductions.
segments.tr: - **تقديم الإقرار بشكل منفصل كزوجين.** هذا يمكن أن يحرمك من بعض هذه الخصومات.

segments.src: - **Claiming unreported tips without records.** The IRS may ask you to show how you arrived at the number.
segments.tr: - **المطالبة بإكراميات غير مبلغ عنها بدون سجلات.** قد تطلب منك مصلحة الضرائب (IRS) إظهار كيف توصلت إلى هذا الرقم.

segments.src: - **Ignoring state taxes.** State rules differ. Some states follow the federal changes, while others do not.
segments.tr: - **تجاهل ضرائب الولاية.** تختلف قواعد الولايات. بعض الولايات تتبع التغييرات الفيدرالية، بينما لا يفعل البعض الآخر.

segments.src: ## What to Do Next
segments.tr: ## ماذا تفعل بعد ذلك

segments.src: 1. Check whether your job appears on the IRS tipped-occupation list, or whether your overtime is FLSA-required.
segments.tr: 1. تحقق مما إذا كانت وظيفتك تظهر في قائمة مهن الإكراميات التابعة لمصلحة الضرائب، أو ما إذا كان عملك الإضافي مطلوباً بموجب قانون معايير العمل العادلة (FLSA).

segments.src: 2. Estimate your MAGI to see whether phase-outs could apply.
segments.tr: 2. قدر دخلك الإجمالي المعدل (MAGI) لمعرفة ما إذا كان يمكن أن تنطبق عمليات التلاشي التدريجي.

segments.src: 3. Run the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator and decide whether to adjust your W-4.
segments.tr: 3. قم بتشغيل "مقدر اقتطاع الضرائب" التابع لمصلحة الضرائب وقرر ما إذا كنت ستعدل نموذج W-4 الخاص بك.

segments.src: 4. Organize your records into one folder, paper or digital, before January.
segments.tr: 4. نظم سجلاتك في مجلد واحد، ورقي أو رقمي، قبل يناير.

segments.src: 5. When filing, use reputable tax software or a licensed preparer, and compare the results against the official IRS instructions.
segments.tr: 5. عند التقديم، استخدم برنامج ضرائب موثوقاً أو معد إقرارات مرخصاً، وقارن النتائج بتعليمات مصلحة الضرائب الرسمية.

segments.src: The new deductions can lower the tax bill for many workers and retirees, but they are not automatic and not unlimited.
segments.tr: يمكن للخصومات الجديدة أن تخفض الفاتورة الضريبية للعديد من العمال والمتقاعدين، لكنها ليست تلقائية وليست غير محدودة.

segments.src: A little record-keeping in the coming weeks can make filing season go much more smoothly.
segments.tr: القليل من حفظ السجلات في الأسابيع المقبلة يمكن أن يجعل موسم التقديم يسير بسلاسة أكبر.

segments.tr: *المصادر التي يجب استشارتها: توجيهات IRS.gov بشأن قانون "One Big Beautiful Bill Act"، وتعليمات نموذج W-4، ومقدر اقتطاع الضرائب.

segments.tr: هذا المحتوى للأغراض المعلوماتية العامة فقط وليس نصيحة قانونية أو ضريبية أو مالية.*

segments.tr: Lorsque la saison des déclarations s'ouvrira au début de 2027, des millions de contribuables découvriront plusieurs nouvelles lignes sur leurs formulaires.

segments.src: The 2025 federal tax law, known as the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, created temporary deductions for qualified tip income, qualified overtime pay and older adults.
segments.tr: La loi fiscale fédérale de 2025, connue sous le nom de One Big Beautiful Bill Act, a créé des déductions temporaires pour les revenus de pourboires admissibles, la rémunération des heures supplémentaires admissibles et les personnes âgées.

segments.src: ## The Big Picture: Deductions, Not Credits
segments.tr: ## La vue d'ensemble : des déductions, pas des crédits

segments.src: These provisions are **deductions**, not credits.
segments.tr: Ces dispositions sont des **déductions**, et non des crédits.

segments.src: A deduction lowers the income your tax is calculated on.
segments.tr: Une déduction réduit le revenu sur lequel votre impôt est calculé.

segments.src: A credit lowers the tax itself, dollar for dollar.
segments.tr: Un crédit réduit l'impôt lui-même, dollar pour dollar.

segments.src: A $1,000 deduction therefore saves you roughly $100 to $370 in federal tax, depending on your tax bracket.
segments.tr: Une déduction de 1 000 $ vous fait donc économiser environ 100 $ à 370 $ d'impôt fédéral, selon votre tranche d'imposition.

segments.src: It does not save you $1,000.
segments.tr: Elle ne vous fait pas économiser 1 000 $.

segments.src: Under the law, these deductions are generally available whether or not you itemize.
segments.tr: En vertu de la loi, ces déductions sont généralement offertes, que vous détaillez vos déductions ou non.

segments.src: You can usually claim them on top of the standard deduction.
segments.tr: Vous pouvez généralement les réclamer en plus de la déduction standard.

segments.src: They are scheduled to apply to tax years 2025 through 2028 unless Congress changes them.
segments.tr: Elles devraient s'appliquer aux années fiscales 2025 à 2028, à moins que le Congrès ne les modifie.

segments.src: ## The Tips Deduction
segments.tr: ## La déduction pour pourboires

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Workers who receive tips in an occupation that customarily and regularly received tips before 2025.
segments.tr: **Qui peut être admissible :** Les travailleurs qui reçoivent des pourboires dans le cadre d'une profession qui recevait habituellement et régulièrement des pourboires avant 2025.

segments.src: The Treasury Department published a list of qualifying occupations.
segments.tr: Le département du Trésor a publié une liste des professions admissibles.

segments.src: It includes jobs such as servers, bartenders, hotel workers, hair and beauty professionals, and delivery drivers.
segments.tr: Elle comprend des emplois tels que serveurs, barmans, employés d'hôtel, professionnels de la coiffure et de l'esthétique, et chauffeurs-livreurs.

segments.src: Check the current list for your job.
segments.tr: Consultez la liste actuelle pour votre emploi.

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **Points clés :**

segments.src: - The deduction is capped at **$25,000** per return for qualified tips.
segments.tr: - La déduction est plafonnée à **$25,000** par déclaration pour les pourboires admissibles.

segments.src: - The tips must be voluntary. A mandatory service charge added to a bill generally does not count.
segments.tr: - Les pourboires doivent être volontaires. Des frais de service obligatoires ajoutés à une facture ne comptent généralement pas.

segments.src: - The deduction begins to phase out when modified adjusted gross income (MAGI) exceeds roughly **$150,000** for single filers and **$300,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - La déduction commence à diminuer lorsque le revenu brut rajusté modifié (MAGI) dépasse environ **$150,000** pour les déclarants seuls et **$300,000** pour les déclarants conjoints.

segments.src: - Self-employed people may qualify in some cases, but the deduction cannot exceed the net income from the business that earned the tips. Certain specified service trades or businesses are excluded.
segments.tr: - Les travailleurs autonomes peuvent être admissibles dans certains cas, mais la déduction ne peut pas dépasser le revenu net de l'entreprise qui a généré les pourboires. Certains métiers ou entreprises de services spécifiés sont exclus.

segments.src: - Married couples generally must file jointly to claim it, and a valid Social Security number is required.
segments.tr: - Les couples mariés doivent généralement produire une déclaration conjointe pour l'obtenir, et un numéro de sécurité sociale valide est requis.

segments.src: - This deduction applies to federal income tax. Social Security and Medicare payroll taxes still apply to tips.
segments.tr: - Cette déduction s'applique à l'impôt sur le revenu fédéral. Les taxes sur la masse salariale de la Sécurité sociale et de Medicare s'appliquent toujours aux pourboires.

segments.src: ## The Overtime Deduction
segments.tr: ## La déduction pour heures supplémentaires

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Employees who are paid overtime required under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).
segments.tr: **Qui peut être admissible :** Les employés qui reçoivent une rémunération pour heures supplémentaires requise par la loi Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **Points clés :**

segments.src: - Only the "premium" portion of overtime counts. If you earn time-and-a-half, the deduction covers the extra half, not the full hourly rate for those hours.
segments.tr: - Seule la partie « majorée » des heures supplémentaires compte. Si vous gagnez une fois et demie votre taux normal, la déduction couvre la moitié supplémentaire, et non le taux horaire complet pour ces heures.

segments.src: - The maximum deduction is **$12,500** for single filers and **$25,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - La déduction maximale est de **$12,500** pour les déclarants seuls et de **$25,000** pour les déclarants conjoints.

segments.src: - The same MAGI phase-out thresholds apply as for tips (roughly $150,000 single, $300,000 joint).
segments.tr: - Les mêmes seuils de réduction du MAGI s'appliquent que pour les pourboires (environ 150 000 $ pour les célibataires, 300 000 $ pour les conjoints).

segments.src: - Overtime paid under a union contract or company policy that goes beyond what the FLSA requires may not qualify.
segments.tr: - Les heures supplémentaires payées en vertu d'une convention collective ou d'une politique d'entreprise qui va au-delà de ce qu'exige la FLSA peuvent ne pas être admissibles.

segments.src: - A valid Social Security number is required, and married couples generally must file jointly.
segments.tr: - Un numéro de sécurité sociale valide est requis, et les couples mariés doivent généralement produire une déclaration conjointe.

segments.src: ## The Senior Deduction
segments.tr: ## La déduction pour personnes âgées

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Taxpayers who are age 65 or older by the end of the tax year.
segments.tr: **Qui peut être admissible :** Les contribuables âgés de 65 ans ou plus d'ici la fin de l'année fiscale.

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **Points clés :**

segments.src: - The additional deduction is **$6,000 per eligible person**. A married couple where both spouses are 65 or older could claim up to $12,000.
segments.tr: - La déduction additionnelle est de **$6,000 per eligible person**. Un couple marié où les deux conjoints ont 65 ans ou plus pourrait réclamer jusqu'à 12 000 $.

segments.src: - It phases out at a rate of 6 cents per dollar of MAGI above about **$75,000** for single filers and **$150,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - Elle diminue au rythme de 6 cents par dollar de MAGI au-dessus d'environ **$75,000** pour les déclarants seuls et de **$150,000** pour les déclarants conjoints.

segments.src: - It is separate from the existing additional standard deduction for people 65 and older, so the two can stack.
segments.tr: - Elle est distincte de la déduction standard additionnelle existante pour les personnes de 65 ans et plus, de sorte que les deux peuvent se cumuler.

segments.src: - You must include a valid Social Security number for each person claimed.
segments.tr: - Vous devez inclure un numéro de sécurité sociale valide pour chaque personne réclamée.

segments.src: ## Auto Loan Interest, Briefly
segments.tr: ## Intérêts sur prêt automobile, en bref

segments.src: A related deduction covers up to **$10,000** of interest a year on a loan for a qualifying new vehicle.
segments.tr: Une déduction connexe couvre jusqu'à **$10,000** d'intérêts par an sur un prêt pour un nouveau véhicule admissible.

segments.src: The vehicle must have final assembly in the United States, and the loan must have been taken out after 2024.
segments.tr: Le véhicule doit avoir subi son assemblage final aux États-Unis, et le prêt doit avoir été contracté après 2024.

segments.src: Income limits apply.
segments.tr: Des limites de revenus s'appliquent.

segments.src: If you bought a car recently, keep your loan statements.
segments.tr: Si vous avez acheté une voiture récemment, conservez vos états de compte de prêt.

segments.src: ## Records to Keep Now
segments.tr: ## Dossiers à conserver dès maintenant

segments.src: The best way to claim these deductions is to document your income as you earn it.
segments.tr: La meilleure façon de réclamer ces déductions est de documenter vos revenus au fur et à mesure que vous les gagnez.

segments.src: Consider these steps before the year ends:
segments.tr: Envisagez ces étapes avant la fin de l'année :

segments.src: 1. **Tipped workers:** Keep a daily log of cash tips, plus card and app tips. Save statements from your employer's payroll or point-of-sale system. If you work through a delivery or rideshare platform, download your year-end earnings summaries.
segments.tr: 1. **Travailleurs au pourboire :** Conservez un journal quotidien des pourboires en espèces, ainsi que des pourboires par carte et par application. Conservez les états de compte de la paie de votre employeur ou de votre système de point de vente. Si vous travaillez par l'intermédiaire d'une plateforme de livraison ou de covoiturage, téléchargez vos résumés de gains de fin d'année.

segments.src: 2. **Overtime earners:** Keep your pay stubs. Make sure you can see regular hours, overtime hours and the overtime rate. Ask your payroll department how overtime is labeled.
segments.tr: 2. **Travailleurs effectuant des heures supplémentaires :** Conservez vos bulletins de paie. Assurez-vous de pouvoir voir les heures régulières, les heures supplémentaires et le taux des heures supplémentaires. Demandez à votre service de paie comment les heures supplémentaires sont étiquetées.

segments.src: 3. **Older adults:** Confirm your date of birth and Social Security number on all your tax records. If you are married, confirm the same for your spouse.
segments.tr: 3. **Adultes plus âgés :** Confirmez votre date de naissance et votre numéro de sécurité sociale sur tous vos dossiers fiscaux. Si vous êtes marié, confirmez de même pour votre conjoint.

segments.src: 4. **Car buyers:** Save the loan agreement, the vehicle identification number (VIN) and interest statements.
segments.tr: 4. **Acheteurs de voitures :** Conservez le contrat de prêt, le numéro d'identification du véhicule (VIN) et les relevés d'intérêts.

segments.src: 5. **Everyone:** Look at your last pay stub of the year and compare it with the W-2 you receive in January. The IRS has been working with employers on new reporting. Expect separate reporting for qualified tips and overtime, but not every employer will have fully adapted. If your W-2 does not break out these amounts, you may need your own records to support the deduction.
segments.tr: 5. **Tout le monde :** Examinez votre dernier bulletin de paie de l'année et comparez-le avec le formulaire W-2 que vous recevez en janvier. L'IRS travaille avec les employeurs sur de nouveaux modes de déclaration. Attendez-vous à des déclarations distinctes pour les pourboires et les heures supplémentaires admissibles, mais tous les employeurs ne se seront pas entièrement adaptés. Si votre formulaire W-2 ne détaille pas ces montants, vous pourriez avoir besoin de vos propres dossiers pour justifier la déduction.

segments.src: ## How Withholding Could Affect Your Refund
segments.tr: ## Comment les retenues peuvent affecter votre remboursement

segments.src: Your refund is simply the difference between what was withheld from your pay during the year and what you actually owe.
segments.tr: Votre remboursement est simplement la différence entre ce qui a été retenu sur votre paie au cours de l'année et ce que vous devez réellement.

segments.src: These new deductions reduce what you owe.
segments.tr: Ces nouvelles déductions réduisent ce que vous devez.

segments.src: They do not automatically reduce what your employer withholds, unless you or your employer adjusts it.
segments.tr: Elles ne réduisent pas automatiquement ce que votre employeur retient, à moins que vous ou votre employeur ne l'ajustiez.

segments.src: - **If your withholding did not change,** you may be overpaying during the year and get a **larger refund** after you claim the deductions.
segments.tr: - **Si vos retenues n'ont pas changé,** vous payez peut-être trop cher pendant l'année et obtiendrez un **remboursement plus important** après avoir réclamé les déductions.

segments.src: - **If you want more take-home pay now,** you can submit a new Form W-4 to your employer, using the deductions worksheet to account for the new deductions. The IRS Tax Withholding Estimator at IRS.gov can help you pick sensible numbers.
segments.tr: - **Si vous voulez un salaire net plus élevé dès maintenant,** vous pouvez soumettre un nouveau formulaire W-4 à votre employeur, en utilisant la feuille de calcul des déductions pour tenir compte des nouvelles déductions. L'estimateur de retenues d'impôt de l'IRS sur IRS.gov peut vous aider à choisir des chiffres raisonnables.

segments.src: - **If you are self-employed or have income without withholding,** the deductions may reduce your quarterly estimated payments. Do not reduce them too far, though, because underpayment penalties can apply.
segments.tr: - **Si vous êtes travailleur autonome ou avez des revenus sans retenue,** les déductions peuvent réduire vos paiements trimestriels estimatifs. Ne les réduisez cependant pas trop, car des pénalités pour insuffisance de versement peuvent s'appliquer.

segments.src: - **Be careful about guessing.** Cutting withholding too much because you expect a deduction can leave you owing money in the spring. That is a risk if you hit the income phase-out, change jobs, or work fewer overtime hours than you expected.
segments.tr: - **Faites attention aux estimations hasardeuses.** Réduire trop les retenues parce que vous vous attendez à une déduction peut vous amener à devoir de l'argent au printemps. C'est un risque si vous atteignez la limite de revenu, changez d'emploi ou travaillez moins d'heures supplémentaires que prévu.

segments.src: A refund is not a bonus from the government.
segments.tr: Un remboursement n'est pas un cadeau du gouvernement.

segments.src: It is your own money returned after the year ends.
segments.tr: Il s'agit de votre propre argent qui vous est restitué après la fin de l'année.

segments.src: Deciding between a big refund and a bigger paycheck is a personal budgeting choice.
segments.tr: Choisir entre un gros remboursement et un plus grand chèque de paie est un choix budgétaire personnel.

segments.src: ## Common Mistakes to Avoid
segments.tr: ## Erreurs courantes à éviter

segments.src: - **Assuming every overtime dollar is deductible.** Only the premium portion of FLSA-required overtime counts.
segments.tr: - **Supposer que chaque dollar d'heures supplémentaires est déductible.** Seule la partie majorée des heures supplémentaires requises par la FLSA compte.

segments.src: - **Forgetting the income limits.** Higher earners may get a reduced deduction or none.
segments.tr: - **Oublier les limites de revenus.** Les hauts revenus peuvent obtenir une déduction réduite ou aucune déduction.

segments.src: - **Filing separately as a married couple.** This can disqualify you from some of these deductions.
segments.tr: - **Produire une déclaration séparée en tant que couple marié.** Cela peut vous disqualifier pour certaines de ces déductions.

segments.src: - **Claiming unreported tips without records.** The IRS may ask you to show how you arrived at the number.
segments.tr: - **Réclamer des pourboires non déclarés sans dossiers.** L'IRS peut vous demander de montrer comment vous êtes arrivé à ce chiffre.

segments.src: - **Ignoring state taxes.** State rules differ. Some states follow the federal changes, while others do not.
segments.tr: - **Ignorer les impôts étatiques.** Les règles des États diffèrent. Certains États suivent les modifications fédérales, tandis que d'autres ne le font pas.

segments.src: ## What to Do Next
segments.tr: ## Que faire ensuite

segments.src: 1. Check whether your job appears on the IRS tipped-occupation list, or whether your overtime is FLSA-required.
segments.tr: 1. Vérifiez si votre emploi figure sur la liste des professions à pourboire de l'IRS, ou si vos heures supplémentaires sont exigées par la FLSA.

segments.src: 2. Estimate your MAGI to see whether phase-outs could apply.
segments.tr: 2. Estimez votre MAGI pour voir si des réductions progressives pourraient s'appliquer.

segments.src: 3. Run the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator and decide whether to adjust your W-4.
segments.tr: 3. Utilisez l'estimateur de retenues d'impôt de l'IRS et décidez s'il faut ajuster votre formulaire W-4.

segments.src: 4. Organize your records into one folder, paper or digital, before January.
segments.tr: 4. Organisez vos dossiers dans un seul dossier, papier ou numérique, avant janvier.

segments.src: 5. When filing, use reputable tax software or a licensed preparer, and compare the results against the official IRS instructions.
segments.tr: 5. Lors de la déclaration, utilisez un logiciel fiscal réputé ou un préparateur autorisé, et comparez les résultats avec les instructions officielles de l'IRS.

segments.tr: Les nouvelles déductions peuvent réduire la facture fiscale de nombreux travailleurs et retraités, mais elles ne sont pas automatiques et ne sont pas illimitées.

segments.src: A little record-keeping in the coming weeks can make filing season go much more smoothly.
segments.tr: Un peu de tenue de registres dans les semaines à venir peut rendre la saison des déclarations beaucoup plus facile.
