pt.title: Prévia da Temporada de Impostos: Como as Novas Deduções de Gorjetas, Horas Extras e para Idosos Podem Moldar sua Declaração de 2026

segments.src: When filing season opens in early 2027, millions of taxpayers will meet several new lines on their returns.
segments.tr: Quando a temporada de declaração começar no início de 2027, milhões de contribuintes encontrarão várias novas linhas em suas declarações.

segments.src: The 2025 federal tax law, known as the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, created temporary deductions for qualified tip income, qualified overtime pay and older adults.
segments.tr: A lei tributária federal de 2025, conhecida como One Big Beautiful Bill Act, criou deduções temporárias para rendimentos qualificados de gorjetas, pagamento qualificado de horas extras e para adultos mais velhos.

segments.src: It also created one for interest on certain new auto loans.
segments.tr: Também criou uma para juros sobre certos novos empréstimos de automóveis.

segments.src: Some workers filed with these items for tax year 2025.
segments.tr: Alguns trabalhadores declararam esses itens no ano fiscal de 2025.

segments.src: For others, the 2026 return will be the first time they matter in a big way.
segments.tr: Para outros, a declaração de 2026 será a primeira vez que eles importarão de forma significativa.

segments.src: The details are specific, and the rules are easy to misread.
segments.tr: Os detalhes são específicos e as regras são fáceis de interpretar erroneamente.

segments.src: This guide explains who may qualify, what records are worth keeping now, and how paycheck withholding can change your refund.
segments.tr: Este guia explica quem pode se qualificar, quais registros vale a pena manter agora e como a retenção na fonte do contracheque pode alterar seu reembolso.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not tax advice.
segments.tr: *Este artigo é uma informação geral, não um conselho fiscal.

segments.src: Rules, forms and IRS guidance can change, so check current IRS materials or talk to a qualified tax professional about your own situation.*
segments.tr: Regras, formulários e orientações do IRS podem mudar, portanto, verifique os materiais atuais do IRS ou fale com um profissional tributário qualificado sobre sua própria situação.*

segments.src: ## The Big Picture: Deductions, Not Credits
segments.tr: ## O Panorama Geral: Deduções, Não Créditos

segments.src: These provisions are **deductions**, not credits.
segments.tr: Essas disposições são **deduções**, não créditos.

segments.src: A deduction lowers the income your tax is calculated on.
segments.tr: Uma dedução reduz a renda sobre a qual seu imposto é calculado.

segments.src: A credit lowers the tax itself, dollar for dollar.
segments.tr: Um crédito reduz o imposto em si, dólar por dólar.

segments.src: A $1,000 deduction therefore saves you roughly $100 to $370 in federal tax, depending on your tax bracket.
segments.tr: Portanto, uma dedução de $1.000 economiza aproximadamente de $100 a $370 em impostos federais, dependendo da sua faixa tributária.

segments.src: It does not save you $1,000.
segments.tr: Não economiza $1.000.

segments.src: Under the law, these deductions are generally available whether or not you itemize.
segments.tr: Pela lei, essas deduções estão geralmente disponíveis, independentemente de você detalhar ou não as despesas.

segments.src: You can usually claim them on top of the standard deduction.
segments.tr: Você geralmente pode reivindicá-las além da dedução padrão.

segments.src: They are scheduled to apply to tax years 2025 through 2028 unless Congress changes them.
segments.tr: Elas estão programadas para se aplicar aos anos fiscais de 2025 a 2028, a menos que o Congresso as altere.

segments.src: ## The Tips Deduction
segments.tr: ## A Dedução de Gorjetas

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Workers who receive tips in an occupation that customarily and regularly received tips before 2025.
segments.tr: **Quem pode se qualificar:** Trabalhadores que recebem gorjetas em uma ocupação que costumeira e regularmente recebia gorjetas antes de 2025.

segments.src: The Treasury Department published a list of qualifying occupations.
segments.tr: O Departamento do Tesouro publicou uma lista de ocupações qualificadas.

segments.src: It includes jobs such as servers, bartenders, hotel workers, hair and beauty professionals, and delivery drivers.
segments.tr: Inclui empregos como garçons, bartenders, funcionários de hotel, profissionais de cabelo e beleza e motoristas de entrega.

segments.src: Check the current list for your job.
segments.tr: Verifique a lista atual para o seu trabalho.

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **Pontos-chave:**

segments.src: - The deduction is capped at **$25,000** per return for qualified tips.
segments.tr: - A dedução é limitada a **$25.000** por declaração para gorjetas qualificadas.

segments.src: - The tips must be voluntary. A mandatory service charge added to a bill generally does not count.
segments.tr: - As gorjetas devem ser voluntárias. Uma taxa de serviço obrigatória adicionada a uma conta geralmente não conta.

segments.src: - The deduction begins to phase out when modified adjusted gross income (MAGI) exceeds roughly **$150,000** for single filers and **$300,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - A dedução começa a ser eliminada gradualmente quando a renda bruta ajustada modificada (MAGI) excede aproximadamente **$150.000** para declarantes solteiros e **$300.000** para declarantes conjuntos.

segments.src: - Self-employed people may qualify in some cases, but the deduction cannot exceed the net income from the business that earned the tips. Certain specified service trades or businesses are excluded.
segments.tr: - Pessoas autônomas podem se qualificar em alguns casos, mas a dedução não pode exceder a renda líquida do negócio que obteve as gorjetas. Certos comércios ou negócios de serviços especificados estão excluídos.

segments.src: - Married couples generally must file jointly to claim it, and a valid Social Security number is required.
segments.tr: - Casais casados geralmente devem declarar em conjunto para reivindicá-la, e um número de Seguro Social válido é necessário.

segments.src: - This deduction applies to federal income tax. Social Security and Medicare payroll taxes still apply to tips.
segments.tr: - Esta dedução aplica-se ao imposto de renda federal. Os impostos sobre a folha de pagamento da Previdência Social e do Medicare ainda se aplicam às gorjetas.

segments.src: ## The Overtime Deduction
segments.tr: ## A Dedução de Horas Extras

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Employees who are paid overtime required under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).
segments.tr: **Quem pode se qualificar:** Funcionários que recebem horas extras exigidas pela Lei de Normas Justas de Trabalho (FLSA).

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **Pontos-chave:**

segments.src: - Only the "premium" portion of overtime counts. If you earn time-and-a-half, the deduction covers the extra half, not the full hourly rate for those hours.
segments.tr: - Apenas a parte "premium" das horas extras conta. Se você ganha hora e meia, a dedução cobre a metade extra, não a taxa horária total para essas horas.

segments.src: - The maximum deduction is **$12,500** for single filers and **$25,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - A dedução máxima é de **$12.500** para declarantes solteiros e **$25.000** para declarantes conjuntos.

segments.src: - The same MAGI phase-out thresholds apply as for tips (roughly $150,000 single, $300,000 joint).
segments.tr: - Aplicam-se os mesmos limites de eliminação gradual de MAGI que para gorjetas (aproximadamente $150.000 para solteiros, $300.000 para conjuntos).

segments.src: - Overtime paid under a union contract or company policy that goes beyond what the FLSA requires may not qualify.
segments.tr: - Horas extras pagas sob um contrato sindical ou política da empresa que vão além do que a FLSA exige podem não se qualificar.

segments.src: - A valid Social Security number is required, and married couples generally must file jointly.
segments.tr: - Um número de Seguro Social válido é necessário, e casais casados geralmente devem declarar em conjunto.

segments.src: ## The Senior Deduction
segments.tr: ## A Dedução para Idosos

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Taxpayers who are age 65 or older by the end of the tax year.
segments.tr: **Quem pode se qualificar:** Contribuintes com 65 anos ou mais até o final do ano fiscal.

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **Pontos-chave:**

segments.src: - The additional deduction is **$6,000 per eligible person**. A married couple where both spouses are 65 or older could claim up to $12,000.
segments.tr: - A dedução adicional é de **$6.000 por pessoa elegível**. Um casal casado onde ambos os cônjuges têm 65 anos ou mais pode reivindicar até $12.000.

segments.src: - It phases out at a rate of 6 cents per dollar of MAGI above about **$75,000** for single filers and **$150,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - Ela é eliminada gradualmente a uma taxa de 6 centavos por dólar de MAGI acima de cerca de **$75.000** para declarantes solteiros e **$150.000** para declarantes conjuntos.

segments.src: - It is separate from the existing additional standard deduction for people 65 and older, so the two can stack.
segments.tr: - É separada da dedução padrão adicional existente para pessoas com 65 anos ou mais, portanto, as duas podem ser acumuladas.

segments.src: - You must include a valid Social Security number for each person claimed.
segments.tr: - Você deve incluir um número de Seguro Social válido para cada pessoa reivindicada.

segments.src: ## Auto Loan Interest, Briefly
segments.tr: ## Juros de Empréstimo de Automóvel, Brevemente

segments.src: A related deduction covers up to **$10,000** of interest a year on a loan for a qualifying new vehicle.
segments.tr: Uma dedução relacionada cobre até **$10.000** de juros por ano em um empréstimo para um veículo novo qualificado.

segments.src: The vehicle must have final assembly in the United States, and the loan must have been taken out after 2024.
segments.tr: O veículo deve ter montagem final nos Estados Unidos, e o empréstimo deve ter sido feito após 2024.

segments.src: Income limits apply.
segments.tr: Limites de renda se aplicam.

segments.src: If you bought a car recently, keep your loan statements.
segments.tr: Se você comprou um carro recentemente, guarde seus extratos de empréstimo.

segments.src: ## Records to Keep Now
segments.tr: ## Registros para Manter Agora

segments.src: The best way to claim these deductions is to document your income as you earn it.
segments.tr: A melhor maneira de reivindicar essas deduções é documentar sua renda à medida que você a ganha.

segments.src: Consider these steps before the year ends:
segments.tr: Considere estas etapas antes que o ano termine:

segments.src: 1. **Tipped workers:** Keep a daily log of cash tips, plus card and app tips. Save statements from your employer's payroll or point-of-sale system. If you work through a delivery or rideshare platform, download your year-end earnings summaries.
segments.tr: 1. **Trabalhadores que recebem gorjetas:** Mantenha um registro diário de gorjetas em dinheiro, além de gorjetas em cartão e aplicativo. Salve extratos da folha de pagamento do seu empregador ou do sistema de ponto de venda. Se você trabalha através de uma plataforma de entrega ou transporte compartilhado, baixe seus resumos de ganhos de fim de ano.

segments.src: 2. **Overtime earners:** Keep your pay stubs. Make sure you can see regular hours, overtime hours and the overtime rate. Ask your payroll department how overtime is labeled.
segments.tr: 2. **Trabalhadores que recebem horas extras:** Guarde seus contracheques. Certifique-se de que você pode ver as horas regulares, horas extras e a taxa de horas extras. Pergunte ao seu departamento de folha de pagamento como as horas extras são rotuladas.

segments.src: 3. **Older adults:** Confirm your date of birth and Social Security number on all your tax records. If you are married, confirm the same for your spouse.
segments.tr: 3. **Adultos mais velhos:** Confirme sua data de nascimento e número de Seguro Social em todos os seus registros fiscais. Se você é casado, confirme o mesmo para seu cônjuge.

segments.src: 4. **Car buyers:** Save the loan agreement, the vehicle identification number (VIN) and interest statements.
segments.tr: 4. **Compradores de carros:** Salve o contrato de empréstimo, o número de identificação do veículo (VIN) e os extratos de juros.

segments.src: 5. **Everyone:** Look at your last pay stub of the year and compare it with the W-2 you receive in January. The IRS has been working with employers on new reporting. Expect separate reporting for qualified tips and overtime, but not every employer will have fully adapted. If your W-2 does not break out these amounts, you may need your own records to support the deduction.
segments.tr: 5. **Todos:** Olhe para o seu último contracheque do ano e compare-o com o W-2 que você recebe em janeiro. O IRS tem trabalhado com os empregadores em novos relatórios. Espere relatórios separados para gorjetas qualificadas e horas extras, mas nem todo empregador terá se adaptado totalmente. Se o seu W-2 não separar esses valores, você pode precisar de seus próprios registros para apoiar a dedução.

segments.src: ## How Withholding Could Affect Your Refund
segments.tr: ## Como a Retenção na Fonte Pode Afetar seu Reembolso

segments.src: Your refund is simply the difference between what was withheld from your pay during the year and what you actually owe.
segments.tr: Seu reembolso é simplesmente a diferença entre o que foi retido do seu pagamento durante o ano e o que você realmente deve.

segments.src: These new deductions reduce what you owe.
segments.tr: Essas novas deduções reduzem o que você deve.

segments.src: They do not automatically reduce what your employer withholds, unless you or your employer adjusts it.
segments.tr: Elas não reduzem automaticamente o que seu empregador retém, a menos que você ou seu empregador ajustem isso.

segments.src: - **If your withholding did not change,** you may be overpaying during the year and get a **larger refund** after you claim the deductions.
segments.tr: - **Se sua retenção não mudou,** você pode estar pagando a mais durante o ano e obter um **reembolso maior** após reivindicar as deduções.

segments.src: - **If you want more take-home pay now,** you can submit a new Form W-4 to your employer, using the deductions worksheet to account for the new deductions. The IRS Tax Withholding Estimator at IRS.gov can help you pick sensible numbers.
segments.tr: - **Se você quiser mais salário líquido agora,** você pode enviar um novo Formulário W-4 ao seu empregador, usando a planilha de deduções para contabilizar as novas deduções. O Estimador de Retenção de Impostos do IRS em IRS.gov pode ajudá-lo a escolher números sensatos.

segments.src: - **If you are self-employed or have income without withholding,** the deductions may reduce your quarterly estimated payments. Do not reduce them too far, though, because underpayment penalties can apply.
segments.tr: - **Se você é autônomo ou tem renda sem retenção na fonte,** as deduções podem reduzir seus pagamentos trimestrais estimados. Não os reduza demais, no entanto, porque penalidades por subpagamento podem ser aplicadas.

segments.src: - **Be careful about guessing.** Cutting withholding too much because you expect a deduction can leave you owing money in the spring. That is a risk if you hit the income phase-out, change jobs, or work fewer overtime hours than you expected.
segments.tr: - **Tenha cuidado ao adivinhar.** Cortar a retenção demais porque você espera uma dedução pode deixá-lo devendo dinheiro na primavera. Esse é um risco se você atingir a eliminação gradual de renda, mudar de emprego ou trabalhar menos horas extras do que esperava.

segments.src: A refund is not a bonus from the government.
segments.tr: Um reembolso não é um bônus do governo.

segments.src: It is your own money returned after the year ends.
segments.tr: É seu próprio dinheiro devolvido após o fim do ano.

segments.src: Deciding between a big refund and a bigger paycheck is a personal budgeting choice.
segments.tr: Decidir entre um grande reembolso e um salário maior é uma escolha de orçamento pessoal.

segments.src: ## Common Mistakes to Avoid
segments.tr: ## Erros Comuns a Evitar

segments.src: - **Assuming every overtime dollar is deductible.** Only the premium portion of FLSA-required overtime counts.
segments.tr: - **Assumir que cada dólar de hora extra é dedutível.** Apenas a parte premium das horas extras exigidas pela FLSA conta.

segments.src: - **Forgetting the income limits.** Higher earners may get a reduced deduction or none.
segments.tr: - **Esquecer os limites de renda.** Ganhadores mais altos podem obter uma dedução reduzida ou nenhuma.

segments.src: - **Filing separately as a married couple.** This can disqualify you from some of these deductions.
segments.tr: - **Declarar separadamente como um casal casado.** Isso pode desqualificá-lo de algumas dessas deduções.

segments.src: - **Claiming unreported tips without records.** The IRS may ask you to show how you arrived at the number.
segments.tr: - **Reivindicar gorjetas não declaradas sem registros.** O IRS pode pedir que você mostre como chegou ao número.

segments.src: - **Ignoring state taxes.** State rules differ. Some states follow the federal changes, while others do not.
segments.tr: - **Ignorar impostos estaduais.** As regras estaduais diferem. Alguns estados seguem as mudanças federais, enquanto outros não.

segments.src: ## What to Do Next
segments.tr: ## O Que Fazer a Seguir

segments.src: 1. Check whether your job appears on the IRS tipped-occupation list, or whether your overtime is FLSA-required.
segments.tr: 1. Verifique se o seu trabalho aparece na lista de ocupações com gorjetas do IRS, ou se suas horas extras são exigidas pela FLSA.

segments.src: 2. Estimate your MAGI to see whether phase-outs could apply.
segments.tr: 2. Estime seu MAGI para ver se as eliminações graduais podem se aplicar.

segments.src: 3. Run the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator and decide whether to adjust your W-4.
segments.tr: 3. Execute o Estimador de Retenção de Impostos do IRS e decida se deve ajustar seu W-4.

segments.src: 4. Organize your records into one folder, paper or digital, before January.
segments.tr: 4. Organize seus registros em uma pasta, física ou digital, antes de janeiro.

segments.src: 5. When filing, use reputable tax software or a licensed preparer, and compare the results against the official IRS instructions.
segments.tr: 5. Ao declarar, use um software tributário respeitável ou um preparador licenciado, e compare os resultados com as instruções oficiais do IRS.

segments.src: The new deductions can lower the tax bill for many workers and retirees, but they are not automatic and not unlimited.
segments.tr: As novas deduções podem reduzir a conta de impostos para muitos trabalhadores e aposentados, mas não são automáticas e não são ilimitadas.

segments.src: A little record-keeping in the coming weeks can make filing season go much more smoothly.
segments.tr: Um pouco de manutenção de registros nas próximas semanas pode tornar a temporada de declaração muito mais tranquila.

segments.tr: *Fontes para consultar: Orientação do IRS.gov sobre o One Big Beautiful Bill Act, as instruções do Formulário W-4 e o Estimador de Retenção de Impostos.

segments.tr: Kredit menurunkan pajak itu sendiri, secara langsung dari dolar ke dolar.

segments.src: A $1,000 deduction therefore saves you roughly $100 to $370 in federal tax, depending on your tax bracket.
segments.tr: Oleh karena itu, potongan sebesar $1,000 menghemat sekitar $100 hingga $370 dalam pajak federal, tergantung pada golongan pajak Anda.

segments.src: It does not save you $1,000.
segments.tr: Ini tidak menghemat $1,000.

segments.src: Under the law, these deductions are generally available whether or not you itemize.
segments.tr: Berdasarkan undang-undang, potongan ini umumnya tersedia terlepas dari apakah Anda merinci potongan Anda atau tidak.

segments.src: You can usually claim them on top of the standard deduction.
segments.tr: Anda biasanya dapat mengklaimnya di atas potongan standar.

segments.src: They are scheduled to apply to tax years 2025 through 2028 unless Congress changes them.
segments.tr: Potongan ini dijadwalkan berlaku untuk tahun pajak 2025 hingga 2028 kecuali Kongres mengubahnya.

segments.src: ## The Tips Deduction
segments.tr: ## Potongan Tip

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Workers who receive tips in an occupation that customarily and regularly received tips before 2025.
segments.tr: **Siapa yang mungkin memenuhi syarat:** Pekerja yang menerima tip dalam pekerjaan yang secara adat dan teratur menerima tip sebelum tahun 2025.

segments.src: The Treasury Department published a list of qualifying occupations.
segments.tr: Departemen Keuangan menerbitkan daftar pekerjaan yang memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: It includes jobs such as servers, bartenders, hotel workers, hair and beauty professionals, and delivery drivers.
segments.tr: Ini mencakup pekerjaan seperti pelayan, bartender, pekerja hotel, profesional tata rambut dan kecantikan, serta pengantar barang.

segments.src: Check the current list for your job.
segments.tr: Periksa daftar saat ini untuk pekerjaan Anda.

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **Poin-poin penting:**

segments.src: - The deduction is capped at **$25,000** per return for qualified tips.
segments.tr: - Potongan dibatasi hingga **$25,000** per SPT untuk tip yang memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: - The tips must be voluntary. A mandatory service charge added to a bill generally does not count.
segments.tr: - Tip harus bersifat sukarela. Biaya layanan wajib yang ditambahkan ke tagihan umumnya tidak dihitung.

segments.src: - The deduction begins to phase out when modified adjusted gross income (MAGI) exceeds roughly **$150,000** for single filers and **$300,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - Potongan mulai berkurang (phase out) ketika pendapatan kotor disesuaikan yang dimodifikasi (MAGI) melebihi sekitar **$150,000** untuk pelapor lajang dan **$300,000** untuk pelapor gabungan.

segments.src: - Self-employed people may qualify in some cases, but the deduction cannot exceed the net income from the business that earned the tips. Certain specified service trades or businesses are excluded.
segments.tr: - Orang yang bekerja sendiri dapat memenuhi syarat dalam beberapa kasus, tetapi potongan tidak boleh melebihi laba bersih dari bisnis yang menghasilkan tip tersebut. Perdagangan atau bisnis jasa tertentu yang ditentukan dikecualikan.

segments.src: - Married couples generally must file jointly to claim it, and a valid Social Security number is required.
segments.tr: - Pasangan suami istri umumnya harus mengajukan SPT bersama untuk mengklaimnya, dan nomor Jaminan Sosial (Social Security number) yang valid diperlukan.

segments.src: - This deduction applies to federal income tax. Social Security and Medicare payroll taxes still apply to tips.
segments.tr: - Potongan ini berlaku untuk pajak penghasilan federal. Pajak penggajian Jaminan Sosial dan Medicare tetap berlaku untuk tip.

segments.src: ## The Overtime Deduction
segments.tr: ## Potongan Lembur

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Employees who are paid overtime required under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).
segments.tr: **Siapa yang mungkin memenuhi syarat:** Karyawan yang dibayar lembur yang diwajibkan di bawah Undang-Undang Standar Ketenagakerjaan yang Adil (FLSA).

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **Poin-poin penting:**

segments.src: - Only the "premium" portion of overtime counts. If you earn time-and-a-half, the deduction covers the extra half, not the full hourly rate for those hours.
segments.tr: - Hanya bagian "premi" dari lembur yang dihitung. Jika Anda memperoleh tarif satu setengah kali lipat, potongan mencakup setengah bagian ekstra, bukan tarif per jam penuh untuk jam-jam tersebut.

segments.src: - The maximum deduction is **$12,500** for single filers and **$25,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - Potongan maksimum adalah **$12,500** untuk pelapor lajang dan **$25,000** untuk pelapor gabungan.

segments.src: - The same MAGI phase-out thresholds apply as for tips (roughly $150,000 single, $300,000 joint).
segments.tr: - Ambang batas pengurangan MAGI yang sama berlaku seperti untuk tip (sekitar $150,000 untuk lajang, $300,000 untuk gabungan).

segments.src: - Overtime paid under a union contract or company policy that goes beyond what the FLSA requires may not qualify.
segments.tr: - Lembur yang dibayarkan berdasarkan kontrak serikat pekerja atau kebijakan perusahaan yang melebihi ketentuan FLSA mungkin tidak memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: - A valid Social Security number is required, and married couples generally must file jointly.
segments.tr: - Nomor Jaminan Sosial yang valid diperlukan, dan pasangan suami istri umumnya harus mengajukan SPT bersama.

segments.src: ## The Senior Deduction
segments.tr: ## Potongan Lansia

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Taxpayers who are age 65 or older by the end of the tax year.
segments.tr: **Siapa yang mungkin memenuhi syarat:** Wajib pajak yang berusia 65 tahun atau lebih pada akhir tahun pajak.

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **Poin-poin penting:**

segments.src: - The additional deduction is **$6,000 per eligible person**. A married couple where both spouses are 65 or older could claim up to $12,000.
segments.tr: - Potongan tambahan adalah **$6,000 per orang yang memenuhi syarat**. Pasangan suami istri di mana kedua belah pihak berusia 65 tahun atau lebih dapat mengklaim hingga $12,000.

segments.src: - It phases out at a rate of 6 cents per dollar of MAGI above about **$75,000** for single filers and **$150,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - Potongan ini berkurang sebesar 6 sen per dolar MAGI di atas sekitar **$75,000** untuk pelapor lajang dan **$150,000** untuk pelapor gabungan.

segments.src: - It is separate from the existing additional standard deduction for people 65 and older, so the two can stack.
segments.tr: - Ini terpisah dari potongan standar tambahan yang ada untuk orang berusia 65 tahun ke atas, sehingga keduanya dapat digabungkan.

segments.src: - You must include a valid Social Security number for each person claimed.
segments.tr: - Anda harus menyertakan nomor Jaminan Sosial yang valid untuk setiap orang yang diklaim.

segments.src: ## Auto Loan Interest, Briefly
segments.tr: ## Bunga Pinjaman Mobil, Singkatnya

segments.src: A related deduction covers up to **$10,000** of interest a year on a loan for a qualifying new vehicle.
segments.tr: Potongan terkait mencakup hingga **$10,000** dari bunga per tahun pada pinjaman untuk kendaraan baru yang memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: The vehicle must have final assembly in the United States, and the loan must have been taken out after 2024.
segments.tr: Kendaraan tersebut harus dirakit akhir di Amerika Serikat, dan pinjaman harus diambil setelah tahun 2024.

segments.src: Income limits apply.
segments.tr: Batasan pendapatan berlaku.

segments.src: If you bought a car recently, keep your loan statements.
segments.tr: Jika Anda baru saja membeli mobil, simpanlah pernyataan pinjaman Anda.

segments.src: ## Records to Keep Now
segments.tr: ## Catatan untuk Disimpan Sekarang

segments.src: The best way to claim these deductions is to document your income as you earn it.
segments.tr: Cara terbaik untuk mengklaim potongan ini adalah dengan mendokumentasikan penghasilan Anda saat Anda mendapatkannya.

segments.src: Consider these steps before the year ends:
segments.tr: Pertimbangkan langkah-langkah ini sebelum tahun berakhir:

segments.src: 1. **Tipped workers:** Keep a daily log of cash tips, plus card and app tips. Save statements from your employer's payroll or point-of-sale system. If you work through a delivery or rideshare platform, download your year-end earnings summaries.
segments.tr: 1. **Pekerja penerima tip:** Simpan catatan harian tip tunai, ditambah tip kartu dan aplikasi. Simpan pernyataan dari sistem penggajian atau titik penjualan (POS) pemberi kerja Anda. Jika Anda bekerja melalui platform pengantaran atau rideshare, unduh ringkasan pendapatan akhir tahun Anda.

segments.src: 2. **Overtime earners:** Keep your pay stubs. Make sure you can see regular hours, overtime hours and the overtime rate. Ask your payroll department how overtime is labeled.
segments.tr: 2. **Pekerja lembur:** Simpan slip gaji Anda. Pastikan Anda dapat melihat jam kerja reguler, jam lembur, dan tarif lembur. Tanyakan kepada bagian penggajian Anda bagaimana lembur diberi label.

segments.src: 3. **Older adults:** Confirm your date of birth and Social Security number on all your tax records. If you are married, confirm the same for your spouse.
segments.tr: 3. **Orang dewasa yang lebih tua:** Konfirmasikan tanggal lahir dan nomor Jaminan Sosial Anda pada semua catatan pajak Anda. Jika Anda sudah menikah, konfirmasikan hal yang sama untuk pasangan Anda.

segments.src: 4. **Car buyers:** Save the loan agreement, the vehicle identification number (VIN) and interest statements.
segments.tr: 4. **Pembeli mobil:** Simpan perjanjian pinjaman, nomor identifikasi kendaraan (VIN), dan pernyataan bunga.

segments.src: 5. **Everyone:** Look at your last pay stub of the year and compare it with the W-2 you receive in January. The IRS has been working with employers on new reporting. Expect separate reporting for qualified tips and overtime, but not every employer will have fully adapted. If your W-2 does not break out these amounts, you may need your own records to support the deduction.
segments.tr: 5. **Semua orang:** Lihat slip gaji terakhir Anda tahun ini dan bandingkan dengan formulir W-2 yang Anda terima pada bulan Januari. IRS telah bekerja sama dengan pemberi kerja mengenai pelaporan baru. Harapkan pelaporan terpisah untuk tip dan lembur yang memenuhi syarat, tetapi tidak semua pemberi kerja akan sepenuhnya beradaptasi. Jika formulir W-2 Anda tidak merinci jumlah ini, Anda mungkin memerlukan catatan Anda sendiri untuk mendukung potongan tersebut.

segments.src: ## How Withholding Could Affect Your Refund
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana Pemotongan Pajak Dapat Memengaruhi Pengembalian Dana Anda

segments.src: Your refund is simply the difference between what was withheld from your pay during the year and what you actually owe.
segments.tr: Pengembalian dana Anda hanyalah selisih antara apa yang dipotong dari gaji Anda selama tahun tersebut dan apa yang sebenarnya Anda utang.

segments.src: These new deductions reduce what you owe.
segments.tr: Potongan baru ini mengurangi apa yang Anda utang.

segments.src: They do not automatically reduce what your employer withholds, unless you or your employer adjusts it.
segments.tr: Potongan ini tidak secara otomatis mengurangi apa yang dipotong oleh pemberi kerja Anda, kecuali Anda atau pemberi kerja Anda menyesuaikannya.

segments.src: - **If your withholding did not change,** you may be overpaying during the year and get a **larger refund** after you claim the deductions.
segments.tr: - **Jika pemotongan Anda tidak berubah,** Anda mungkin membayar terlalu banyak selama tahun tersebut dan mendapatkan **pengembalian dana yang lebih besar** setelah Anda mengklaim potongan tersebut.

segments.src: - **If you want more take-home pay now,** you can submit a new Form W-4 to your employer, using the deductions worksheet to account for the new deductions. The IRS Tax Withholding Estimator at IRS.gov can help you pick sensible numbers.
segments.tr: - **Jika Anda menginginkan lebih banyak gaji bawa pulang sekarang,** Anda dapat menyerahkan Formulir W-4 baru kepada pemberi kerja Anda, dengan menggunakan lembar kerja potongan untuk memperhitungkan potongan baru. Estimator Pemotongan Pajak IRS di IRS.gov dapat membantu Anda memilih angka yang masuk akal.

segments.src: - **If you are self-employed or have income without withholding,** the deductions may reduce your quarterly estimated payments. Do not reduce them too far, though, because underpayment penalties can apply.
segments.tr: - **Jika Anda bekerja sendiri atau memiliki penghasilan tanpa pemotongan,** potongan tersebut dapat mengurangi pembayaran estimasi kuartalan Anda. Namun, jangan terlalu menguranginya, karena penalti pembayaran kurang dapat berlaku.

segments.src: - **Be careful about guessing.** Cutting withholding too much because you expect a deduction can leave you owing money in the spring. That is a risk if you hit the income phase-out, change jobs, or work fewer overtime hours than you expected.
segments.tr: - **Berhati-hatilah dalam menebak.** Terlalu banyak memotong pemotongan karena Anda mengharapkan potongan dapat membuat Anda berutang uang di musim semi. Itu adalah risiko jika Anda mencapai batas fase pendapatan, berganti pekerjaan, atau bekerja lebih sedikit jam lembur dari yang Anda harapkan.

segments.src: A refund is not a bonus from the government.
segments.tr: Pengembalian dana bukanlah bonus dari pemerintah.

segments.src: It is your own money returned after the year ends.
segments.tr: Itu adalah uang Anda sendiri yang dikembalikan setelah tahun berakhir.

segments.src: Deciding between a big refund and a bigger paycheck is a personal budgeting choice.
segments.tr: Memutuskan antara pengembalian dana besar dan gaji yang lebih besar adalah pilihan penganggaran pribadi.

segments.src: ## Common Mistakes to Avoid
segments.tr: ## Kesalahan Umum yang Harus Dihindari

segments.src: - **Assuming every overtime dollar is deductible.** Only the premium portion of FLSA-required overtime counts.
segments.tr: - **Mengasumsikan setiap dolar lembur dapat dikurangkan.** Hanya bagian premi dari lembur yang diwajibkan FLSA yang dihitung.

segments.src: - **Forgetting the income limits.** Higher earners may get a reduced deduction or none.
segments.tr: - **Lupa batasan pendapatan.** Orang berpenghasilan tinggi mungkin mendapatkan potongan yang dikurangi atau tidak sama sekali.

segments.src: - **Filing separately as a married couple.** This can disqualify you from some of these deductions.
segments.tr: - **Mengajukan secara terpisah sebagai pasangan suami istri.** Ini dapat mendiskualifikasi Anda dari beberapa potongan ini.

segments.src: - **Claiming unreported tips without records.** The IRS may ask you to show how you arrived at the number.
segments.tr: - **Mengklaim tip yang tidak dilaporkan tanpa catatan.** IRS mungkin meminta Anda untuk menunjukkan bagaimana Anda sampai pada angka tersebut.

segments.src: - **Ignoring state taxes.** State rules differ. Some states follow the federal changes, while others do not.
segments.tr: - **Mengabaikan pajak negara bagian.** Aturan negara bagian berbeda-beda. Beberapa negara bagian mengikuti perubahan federal, sementara yang lain tidak.

segments.src: ## What to Do Next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Harus Dilakukan Selanjutnya

segments.src: 1. Check whether your job appears on the IRS tipped-occupation list, or whether your overtime is FLSA-required.
segments.tr: 1. Periksa apakah pekerjaan Anda muncul di daftar pekerjaan tip IRS, atau apakah lembur Anda diwajibkan oleh FLSA.

segments.src: 2. Estimate your MAGI to see whether phase-outs could apply.
segments.tr: 2. Perkirakan MAGI Anda untuk melihat apakah fase pengurangan (phase-out) dapat berlaku.

segments.src: 3. Run the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator and decide whether to adjust your W-4.
segments.tr: 3. Jalankan Estimator Pemotongan Pajak IRS dan tentukan apakah akan menyesuaikan W-4 Anda.

segments.src: 4. Organize your records into one folder, paper or digital, before January.
segments.tr: 4. Atur catatan Anda ke dalam satu folder, cetak atau digital, sebelum bulan Januari.

segments.src: 5. When filing, use reputable tax software or a licensed preparer, and compare the results against the official IRS instructions.
segments.tr: 5. Saat mengajukan, gunakan perangkat lunak pajak yang memiliki reputasi baik atau pembuat pajak berlisensi, dan bandingkan hasilnya dengan instruksi resmi IRS.

segments.src: The new deductions can lower the tax bill for many workers and retirees, but they are not automatic and not unlimited.
segments.tr: Potongan baru ini dapat menurunkan tagihan pajak bagi banyak pekerja dan pensiunan, tetapi potongan tersebut tidak otomatis dan tidak terbatas.

segments.src: A little record-keeping in the coming weeks can make filing season go much more smoothly.
segments.tr: Sedikit penyimpanan catatan dalam beberapa minggu mendatang dapat membuat musim pengisian pajak berjalan jauh lebih lancar.

segments.src: *Sources to consult: IRS.gov guidance on the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, the Form W-4 instructions, and the Tax Withholding Estimator.
segments.tr: *Sumber untuk dikonsultasikan: Panduan IRS.gov tentang One Big Beautiful Bill Act, instruksi Formulir W-4, dan Estimator Pemotongan Pajak.

segments.src: This content is for general information only and is not legal, tax or financial advice.*
segments.tr: Konten ini hanya untuk informasi umum dan bukan merupakan nasihat hukum, pajak, atau keuangan.*

ja.title: タックスシーズンプレビュー：新しいチップ、残業手当、高齢者控除が2026年分の確定申告に与える影響

segments.src: When filing season opens in early 2027, millions of taxpayers will meet several new lines on their returns.
segments.tr: 2027年早々に申告シーズンが始まると、何百万人もの納税者が申告書上でいくつかの新しい欄に直面することになります。

segments.src: The 2025 federal tax law, known as the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, created temporary deductions for qualified tip income, qualified overtime pay and older adults.
segments.tr: 「One Big Beautiful Bill Act（ワン・ビッグ・ビューティフル・ビル法）」として知られる2025年の連邦税法は、適格なチップ収入、適格な残業手当、および高齢者向けの臨時控除を新設しました。

segments.src: It also created one for interest on certain new auto loans.
segments.tr: また、特定の新車ローンに対する利息の控除も新設されました。

segments.src: Some workers filed with these items for tax year 2025.
segments.tr: 一部の労働者は2025課税年度ですでにこれらを申告しました。

segments.src: For others, the 2026 return will be the first time they matter in a big way.
segments.tr: 他の人にとっては、2026年分の申告がこれらが大きく影響する最初の機会となります。

segments.src: The details are specific, and the rules are easy to misread.
segments.tr: 詳細は具体的であり、ルールは誤解されやすいものです。

segments.src: This guide explains who may qualify, what records are worth keeping now, and how paycheck withholding can change your refund.
segments.tr: このガイドでは、対象となる可能性のある人、今保存しておくべき記録、そして源泉徴収額が還付金にどのように影響するかを説明します。

segments.src: *This article is general information, not tax advice.
segments.tr: *この記事は一般情報であり、税務上のアドバイスではありません。

segments.src: Rules, forms and IRS guidance can change, so check current IRS materials or talk to a qualified tax professional about your own situation.*
segments.tr: ルール、フォーム、IRSのガイダンスは変更される可能性があるため、ご自身の状況については、最新のIRSの資料を確認するか、適格な税理士にご相談ください.*

segments.src: ## The Big Picture: Deductions, Not Credits
segments.tr: ## 全体像：税額控除ではなく所得控除

segments.src: These provisions are **deductions**, not credits.
segments.tr: これらの規定は税額控除（クレジット）ではなく、**所得控除（ディダクション）**です。

segments.src: A deduction lowers the income your tax is calculated on.
segments.tr: 控除により、税額の計算基礎となる所得が減少します。

segments.src: A credit lowers the tax itself, dollar for dollar.
segments.tr: 税額控除は税金そのものを1対1で直接軽減します。

segments.src: A $1,000 deduction therefore saves you roughly $100 to $370 in federal tax, depending on your tax bracket.
segments.tr: したがって、1,000ドルの所得控除は、税率に応じて連邦税を約100ドルから370ドル節約することになります。

segments.src: It does not save you $1,000.
segments.tr: 1,000ドルそのまま節約されるわけではありません。

segments.src: Under the law, these deductions are generally available whether or not you itemize.
segments.tr: 法律に基づき、これらの控除は原則として項目別控除をするかどうかにかかわらず利用できます。

segments.src: You can usually claim them on top of the standard deduction.
segments.tr: 通常、基礎控除（スタンダード・ディダクション）に上乗せして請求することができます。

segments.src: They are scheduled to apply to tax years 2025 through 2028 unless Congress changes them.
segments.tr: 議会による変更がない限り、2025課税年度から2028課税年度まで適用される予定です。

segments.src: ## The Tips Deduction
segments.tr: ## チップ控除

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Workers who receive tips in an occupation that customarily and regularly received tips before 2025.
segments.tr: **対象となり得る人：**2025年以前から慣習的かつ定期的にチップを受け取っている職種でチップを受け取る労働者。

segments.src: The Treasury Department published a list of qualifying occupations.
segments.tr: 財務省は対象となる職種のリストを公表しています。

segments.src: It includes jobs such as servers, bartenders, hotel workers, hair and beauty professionals, and delivery drivers.
segments.tr: これには、ウェイター、バーテンダー、ホテル従業員、理美容師、配達ドライバーなどの仕事が含まれます。

segments.src: Check the current list for your job.
segments.tr: ご自身の職種については最新のリストをご確認ください。

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **主なポイント：**

segments.src: - The deduction is capped at **$25,000** per return for qualified tips.
segments.tr: - 適格なチップに対する控除額は、申告書あたり最大**$25,000**に制限されます。

segments.src: - The tips must be voluntary. A mandatory service charge added to a bill generally does not count.
segments.tr: - チップは自主的なものでなければなりません。請求書に追加される強制的なサービス料は通常対象外です。

segments.src: - The deduction begins to phase out when modified adjusted gross income (MAGI) exceeds roughly **$150,000** for single filers and **$300,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - 修正調整総所得（MAGI）が、単身申告者の場合は約**$150,000**、夫婦合算申告者の場合は約**$300,000**を超えると、控除額の段階的縮小（フェーズアウト）が始まります。

segments.src: - Self-employed people may qualify in some cases, but the deduction cannot exceed the net income from the business that earned the tips. Certain specified service trades or businesses are excluded.
segments.tr: - 自営業者は場合によって対象となる可能性がありますが、控除額はチップを得た事業の純利益を超えることはできません。特定の指定されたサービス業や事業は除外されます。

segments.src: - Married couples generally must file jointly to claim it, and a valid Social Security number is required.
segments.tr: - 既婚者の場合は通常、控除を申請するには夫婦合算で申告する必要があり、有効な社会保障番号（SSN）が必要です。

segments.src: - This deduction applies to federal income tax. Social Security and Medicare payroll taxes still apply to tips.
segments.tr: - この控除は連邦所得税に適用されます。社会保障税およびメディケアの給与税は引き続きチップに適用されます。

segments.src: ## The Overtime Deduction
segments.tr: ## 残業手当控除

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Employees who are paid overtime required under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).
segments.tr: **対象となり得る人：**公正労働基準法（FLSA）で義務付けられた残業手当を受け取っている従業員。

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **主なポイント：**

segments.src: - Only the "premium" portion of overtime counts. If you earn time-and-a-half, the deduction covers the extra half, not the full hourly rate for those hours.
segments.tr: - 残業の「割増」部分のみが対象となります。1.5倍の時間外手当を受け取る場合、控除の対象となるのはその時間の通常の時給ではなく、上乗せされた半分（0.5分）です。

segments.src: - The maximum deduction is **$12,500** for single filers and **$25,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - 最大控除額は、単身申告者が**$12,500**、夫婦合算申告者が**$25,000**です。

segments.src: - The same MAGI phase-out thresholds apply as for tips (roughly $150,000 single, $300,000 joint).
segments.tr: - チップと同様のMAGIフェーズアウト基準が適用されます（単身約$150,000、合算約$300,000）。

segments.src: - Overtime paid under a union contract or company policy that goes beyond what the FLSA requires may not qualify.
segments.tr: - 労働組合の契約や、FLSAの要件を超える会社の方針に基づいて支払われた残業手当は、対象外となる場合があります。

segments.src: - A valid Social Security number is required, and married couples generally must file jointly.
segments.tr: - 有効な社会保障番号が必要であり、既婚者は原則として合算申告する必要があります。

segments.src: ## The Senior Deduction
segments.tr: ## 高齢者控除

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Taxpayers who are age 65 or older by the end of the tax year.
segments.tr: **対象となり得る人：**課税年度末時点で65歳以上の納税者。

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **主なポイント：**

segments.src: - The additional deduction is **$6,000 per eligible person**. A married couple where both spouses are 65 or older could claim up to $12,000.
segments.tr: - 追加控除額は**対象者1人につき$6,000**です。夫婦ともに65歳以上の場合は、最大$12,000を請求できます。

segments.src: - It phases out at a rate of 6 cents per dollar of MAGI above about **$75,000** for single filers and **$150,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - 単身申告者で約**$75,000**、夫婦合算申告者で約**$150,000**を超えるMAGIの1ドルにつき6セントの割合で段階的に縮小します。

segments.src: - It is separate from the existing additional standard deduction for people 65 and older, so the two can stack.
segments.tr: - 65歳以上の人のための既存の追加標準控除とは別個のものであるため、2つを重ねて適用（スタック）できます。

segments.src: - You must include a valid Social Security number for each person claimed.
segments.tr: - 申請する人ごとに有効な社会保障番号を記載する必要があります。

segments.src: ## Auto Loan Interest, Briefly
segments.tr: ## 自動車ローン利息の概要

segments.src: A related deduction covers up to **$10,000** of interest a year on a loan for a qualifying new vehicle.
segments.tr: 関連する控除として、適格な新車のローンに対する年間最大**$10,000**の利息が対象となります。

segments.src: The vehicle must have final assembly in the United States, and the loan must have been taken out after 2024.
segments.tr: 車両は米国で最終組み立てが行われたものでなければならず、ローンは2024年以降に組まれたものである必要があります。

segments.src: Income limits apply.
segments.tr: 所得制限が適用されます。

segments.src: If you bought a car recently, keep your loan statements.
segments.tr: 最近車を購入した場合は、ローンの明細書を保管しておいてください。

segments.src: ## Records to Keep Now
segments.tr: ## 今すぐ保管しておくべき記録

segments.src: The best way to claim these deductions is to document your income as you earn it.
segments.tr: これらの控除を申請する最善の方法は、所得を得た時点でその記録を残すことです。

segments.src: Consider these steps before the year ends:
segments.tr: 年末を迎える前に以下の手順を検討してください：

segments.src: 1. **Tipped workers:** Keep a daily log of cash tips, plus card and app tips. Save statements from your employer's payroll or point-of-sale system. If you work through a delivery or rideshare platform, download your year-end earnings summaries.
segments.tr: 1. **チップを受け取る労働者：**現金チップ、およびカードやアプリのチップの毎日の記録を保管します。雇用主の給与システムやPOSシステムの明細書を保存します。配達やライドシェアのプラットフォームを通じて働いている場合は、年末の収益サマリーをダウンロードします。

segments.src: 2. **Overtime earners:** Keep your pay stubs. Make sure you can see regular hours, overtime hours and the overtime rate. Ask your payroll department how overtime is labeled.
segments.tr: 2. **残業手当を受け取る労働者：**給与明細（ペイスタブ）を保管します。通常労働時間、残業時間、残業手当の率が確認できるようにしておきます。残業がどのように表記されているかを給与担当部門に確認してください。

segments.src: 3. **Older adults:** Confirm your date of birth and Social Security number on all your tax records. If you are married, confirm the same for your spouse.
segments.tr: 3. **高齢者：**すべての税務記録で生年月日と社会保障番号を確認します。既婚者の場合は、配偶者についても同様に確認します。

segments.src: 4. **Car buyers:** Save the loan agreement, the vehicle identification number (VIN) and interest statements.
segments.tr: 4. **自動車購入者：**ローン契約書、車両識別番号（VIN）、および利息の明細書を保存します。

segments.src: 5. **Everyone:** Look at your last pay stub of the year and compare it with the W-2 you receive in January. The IRS has been working with employers on new reporting. Expect separate reporting for qualified tips and overtime, but not every employer will have fully adapted. If your W-2 does not break out these amounts, you may need your own records to support the deduction.
segments.tr: 5. **すべての人：**その年最後の給与明細を確認し、1月に受け取るW-2（源泉徴収票）と照らし合わせます。IRSは新しい報告について雇用主と協力してきました。適格なチップと残業手当については個別の報告が予想されますが、すべての雇用主が完全に対応しているわけではありません。W-2にこれらの金額の内訳が記載されていない場合は、控除を裏付けるためにご自身の記録が必要になることがあります。

segments.src: ## How Withholding Could Affect Your Refund
segments.tr: ## 源泉徴収が還付金に与える影響

segments.src: Your refund is simply the difference between what was withheld from your pay during the year and what you actually owe.
segments.tr: 還付金とは単に、その年の間に給与から源泉徴収された額と、実際に支払うべき税額との差額です。

segments.src: These new deductions reduce what you owe.
segments.tr: これらの新しい控除により、支払うべき税額が軽減されます。

segments.src: They do not automatically reduce what your employer withholds, unless you or your employer adjusts it.
segments.tr: あなたや雇用主が調整を行わない限り、雇用主が源泉徴収する金額が自動的に減るわけではありません。

segments.src: - **If your withholding did not change,** you may be overpaying during the year and get a **larger refund** after you claim the deductions.
segments.tr: - **源泉徴収額に変更がない場合、**年間を通じて払いすぎている可能性があり、控除を申請した後に**より多くの還付金**を受け取ることになります。

segments.src: - **If you want more take-home pay now,** you can submit a new Form W-4 to your employer, using the deductions worksheet to account for the new deductions. The IRS Tax Withholding Estimator at IRS.gov can help you pick sensible numbers.
segments.tr: - **手取り収入を今すぐ増やしたい場合、**新しい控除を考慮するための控除ワークシートを使用して、新しいForm W-4を雇用主に提出できます。IRS.govのIRS税金源泉徴収見積もりツール（Tax Withholding Estimator）は、適切な数値を選ぶのに役立ちます。

segments.src: - **If you are self-employed or have income without withholding,** the deductions may reduce your quarterly estimated payments. Do not reduce them too far, though, because underpayment penalties can apply.
segments.tr: - **自営業である場合や、源泉徴収されない所得がある場合、**これらの控除により四半期の予定納税額が減額される可能性があります。ただし、過少納付ペナルティが適用される可能性があるため、減らしすぎないようにしてください。

segments.src: - **Be careful about guessing.** Cutting withholding too much because you expect a deduction can leave you owing money in the spring. That is a risk if you hit the income phase-out, change jobs, or work fewer overtime hours than you expected.
segments.tr: - **推測で行う場合は注意してください。**控除を見込んで源泉徴収を減らしすぎると、春に納税義務が生じる可能性があります。所得制限に達したり、転職したり、予想よりも残業時間が少なくなったりした場合に、これはリスクとなります。

segments.src: A refund is not a bonus from the government.
segments.tr: 還付金は政府からのボーナスではありません。

segments.src: It is your own money returned after the year ends.
segments.tr: 年末が終わった後に戻ってくるあなた自身の資金です。

segments.src: Deciding between a big refund and a bigger paycheck is a personal budgeting choice.
segments.tr: 多額の還付金とより多い手取り給与のどちらを選ぶかは、個人の家計管理の選択です。

segments.src: ## Common Mistakes to Avoid
segments.tr: ## 避けるべきよくある間違い

segments.src: - **Assuming every overtime dollar is deductible.** Only the premium portion of FLSA-required overtime counts.
segments.tr: - **すべての残業代が控除対象になると仮定すること。**FLSAで義務付けられた残業の割増部分のみが対象となります。

segments.src: - **Forgetting the income limits.** Higher earners may get a reduced deduction or none.
segments.tr: - **所得制限を忘れること。**高所得者は控除額が減額されるか、全く控除されない場合があります。

segments.src: - **Filing separately as a married couple.** This can disqualify you from some of these deductions.
segments.tr: - **既婚者で別々に申告すること。**これにより、これらの控除の一部を受ける資格が失われる可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Claiming unreported tips without records.** The IRS may ask you to show how you arrived at the number.
segments.tr: - **記録なしで未申告のチップを請求すること。**IRSはその数字にどのように達したかを示すよう求める場合があります。

segments.src: - **Ignoring state taxes.** State rules differ. Some states follow the federal changes, while others do not.
segments.tr: - **州税を無視すること。**州のルールは異なります。連邦の変更に従う州もあれば、そうでない州もあります。

segments.src: ## What to Do Next
segments.tr: ## 次にすべきこと

segments.src: 1. Check whether your job appears on the IRS tipped-occupation list, or whether your overtime is FLSA-required.
segments.tr: 1. 自分の職種がIRSのチップ対象職種リストに載っているか、または残業がFLSAで義務付けられたものかを確認します。

segments.src: 2. Estimate your MAGI to see whether phase-outs could apply.
segments.tr: 2. MAGIを試算し、フェーズアウトが適用されるかどうかを確認します。

segments.src: 3. Run the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator and decide whether to adjust your W-4.
segments.tr: 3. IRS税金源泉徴収見積もりツールを実行し、W-4を調整するかどうかを決定します。

segments.src: 4. Organize your records into one folder, paper or digital, before January.
segments.tr: 4. 1月になる前に、紙またはデジタルで記録を1つのフォルダーに整理します。

segments.src: 5. When filing, use reputable tax software or a licensed preparer, and compare the results against the official IRS instructions.
segments.tr: 5. 申告の際は、信頼できる税務ソフトまたはライセンスを持った申告代行者を使用し、公式のIRSの指示と結果を比較します。

segments.src: The new deductions can lower the tax bill for many workers and retirees, but they are not automatic and not unlimited.
segments.tr: 新しい控除は多くの労働者や退職者の税負担を軽減しますが、自動的ではなく、無制限でもありません。

segments.src: A little record-keeping in the coming weeks can make filing season go much more smoothly.
segments.tr: これからの数週間で少し記録をつけておくことで、申告シーズンをはるかにスムーズに進めることができます。

segments.tr: *参照すべき情報源：One Big Beautiful Bill Actに関するIRS.govのガイダンス、Form W-4の指示、および税金源泉徴収見積もりツール。

segments.src: ## The Big Picture: Deductions, Not Credits
segments.tr: ## Das große Ganze: Abzüge, keine Gutschriften

segments.src: These provisions are **deductions**, not credits.
segments.tr: Diese Bestimmungen sind **Abzüge** (deductions), keine Gutschriften (credits).

segments.src: A deduction lowers the income your tax is calculated on.
segments.tr: Ein Abzug senkt das Einkommen, auf das Ihre Steuer berechnet wird.

segments.src: A credit lowers the tax itself, dollar for dollar.
segments.tr: Eine Gutschrift senkt die Steuer selbst, Dollar für Dollar.

segments.src: A $1,000 deduction therefore saves you roughly $100 to $370 in federal tax, depending on your tax bracket.
segments.tr: Ein Abzug von 1.000 $ spart Ihnen daher je nach Steuerklasse grob 100 bis 370 $ an Bundessteuer.

segments.src: It does not save you $1,000.
segments.tr: Er spart Ihnen keine 1.000 $.

segments.src: Under the law, these deductions are generally available whether or not you itemize.
segments.tr: Dem Gesetz nach sind diese Abzüge im Allgemeinen unabhängig davon verfügbar, ob Sie Posten einzeln aufführen (itemize) oder nicht.

segments.src: You can usually claim them on top of the standard deduction.
segments.tr: Sie können sie normalerweise zusätzlich zum Standardabzug geltend machen.

segments.src: They are scheduled to apply to tax years 2025 through 2028 unless Congress changes them.
segments.tr: Sie sind so angesetzt, dass sie für die Steuerjahre 2025 bis 2028 gelten, es sei denn, der Kongress ändert sie.

segments.src: ## The Tips Deduction
segments.tr: ## Der Trinkgeldabzug

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Workers who receive tips in an occupation that customarily and regularly received tips before 2025.
segments.tr: **Wer Anspruch haben könnte:** Arbeitnehmer, die Trinkgelder in einem Beruf erhalten, in dem vor 2025 üblicherweise und regelmäßig Trinkgelder erhalten wurden.

segments.src: The Treasury Department published a list of qualifying occupations.
segments.tr: Das Finanzministerium hat eine Liste qualifizierender Berufe veröffentlicht.

segments.src: It includes jobs such as servers, bartenders, hotel workers, hair and beauty professionals, and delivery drivers.
segments.tr: Sie umfasst Jobs wie Kellner, Barkeeper, Hotelangestellte, Haar- und Schönheitsexperten sowie Lieferfahrer.

segments.src: Check the current list for your job.
segments.tr: Überprüfen Sie die aktuelle Liste für Ihren Job.

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **Wichtige Punkte:**

segments.src: - The deduction is capped at **$25,000** per return for qualified tips.
segments.tr: - Der Abzug ist auf **25.000 $** pro Steuererklärung für qualifizierte Trinkgelder begrenzt.

segments.src: - The tips must be voluntary. A mandatory service charge added to a bill generally does not count.
segments.tr: - Die Trinkgelder müssen freiwillig sein. Eine zu einer Rechnung hinzugefügte obligatorische Servicegebühr zählt im Allgemeinen nicht.

segments.src: - The deduction begins to phase out when modified adjusted gross income (MAGI) exceeds roughly **$150,000** for single filers and **$300,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - Der Abzug beginnt sich auszuphasen (phase out), wenn das modifizierte bereinigte Bruttoeinkommen (MAGI) für Alleinstehende roughly **150.000 $** und für Zusammenveranlagte **300.000 $** übersteigt.

segments.src: - Self-employed people may qualify in some cases, but the deduction cannot exceed the net income from the business that earned the tips. Certain specified service trades or businesses are excluded.
segments.tr: - Selbstständige können sich in einigen Fällen qualifizieren, aber der Abzug darf das Nettoeinkommen aus dem Unternehmen, das die Trinkgelder verdient hat, nicht übersteigen. Bestimmte spezifizierte Dienstleistungsgewerbe oder -unternehmen sind ausgeschlossen.

segments.src: - Married couples generally must file jointly to claim it, and a valid Social Security number is required.
segments.tr: - Verheiratete Paare müssen im Allgemeinen gemeinsam veranlagt werden, um ihn geltend zu machen, und eine gültige Sozialversicherungsnummer ist erforderlich.

segments.src: - This deduction applies to federal income tax. Social Security and Medicare payroll taxes still apply to tips.
segments.tr: - Dieser Abzug gilt für die Bundeseinkommensteuer. Sozialversicherungs- und Medicare-Lohnsteuern fallen weiterhin auf Trinkgelder an.

segments.src: ## The Overtime Deduction
segments.tr: ## Der Überstundenabzug

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Employees who are paid overtime required under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).
segments.tr: **Wer Anspruch haben könnte:** Arbeitnehmer, denen Überstunden vergütet werden, die nach dem Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) vorgeschrieben sind.

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **Wichtige Punkte:**

segments.src: - Only the "premium" portion of overtime counts. If you earn time-and-a-half, the deduction covers the extra half, not the full hourly rate for those hours.
segments.tr: - Nur der "Zuschlagsteil" (premium portion) der Überstunden zählt. Wenn Sie das Anderthalbfache verdienen, deckt der Abzug die zusätzliche Hälfte ab, nicht den vollen Stundensatz für diese Stunden.

segments.src: - The maximum deduction is **$12,500** for single filers and **$25,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - Der maximale Abzug beträgt **12.500 $** für Alleinstehende und **25.000 $** für Zusammenveranlagte.

segments.src: - The same MAGI phase-out thresholds apply as for tips (roughly $150,000 single, $300,000 joint).
segments.tr: - Es gelten dieselben MAGI-Auslaufschwellen wie für Trinkgelder (ca. 150.000 $ für Alleinstehende, 300.000 $ für Zusammenveranlagte).

segments.src: - Overtime paid under a union contract or company policy that goes beyond what the FLSA requires may not qualify.
segments.tr: - Überstunden, die im Rahmen eines Gewerkschaftsvertrags oder einer Unternehmensrichtlinie gezahlt werden, die über das vom FLSA geforderte Maß hinausgehen, qualifizieren sich möglicherweise nicht.

segments.src: - A valid Social Security number is required, and married couples generally must file jointly.
segments.tr: - Eine gültige Sozialversicherungsnummer ist erforderlich, und verheiratete Paare müssen im Allgemeinen gemeinsam veranlagen.

segments.src: ## The Senior Deduction
segments.tr: ## Der Seniorenabzug

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Taxpayers who are age 65 or older by the end of the tax year.
segments.tr: **Wer Anspruch haben könnte:** Steuerzahler, die am Ende des Steuerjahres 65 Jahre oder älter sind.

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **Wichtige Punkte:**

segments.src: - The additional deduction is **$6,000 per eligible person**. A married couple where both spouses are 65 or older could claim up to $12,000.
segments.tr: - Der zusätzliche Abzug beträgt **6.000 $ pro berechtigter Person**. Ein Ehepaar, bei dem beide Ehepartner 65 oder älter sind, könnte bis zu 12.000 $ geltend machen.

segments.src: - It phases out at a rate of 6 cents per dollar of MAGI above about **$75,000** for single filers and **$150,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - Er läuft mit einer Rate von 6 Cent pro Dollar MAGI über etwa **75.000 $** für Alleinstehende und **150.000 $** für Zusammenveranlagte aus.

segments.src: - It is separate from the existing additional standard deduction for people 65 and older, so the two can stack.
segments.tr: - Er ist unabhängig von dem bestehenden zusätzlichen Standardabzug für Personen ab 65 Jahren, sodass sich die beiden stapeln können.

segments.src: - You must include a valid Social Security number for each person claimed.
segments.tr: - Sie müssen für jede beanspruchte Person eine gültige Sozialversicherungsnummer angeben.

segments.src: ## Auto Loan Interest, Briefly
segments.tr: **Autokreditzinsen, kurz gefasst**

segments.src: A related deduction covers up to **$10,000** of interest a year on a loan for a qualifying new vehicle.
segments.tr: Ein verwandter Abzug deckt bis zu **10.000 $** an Zinsen pro Jahr für ein Darlehen für ein qualifizierendes Neufahrzeug ab.

segments.src: The vehicle must have final assembly in the United States, and the loan must have been taken out after 2024.
segments.tr: Das Fahrzeug muss seine Endmontage in den Vereinigten Staaten haben, und das Darlehen muss nach 2024 aufgenommen worden sein.

segments.src: Income limits apply.
segments.tr: Es gelten Einkommensgrenzen.

segments.src: If you bought a car recently, keep your loan statements.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie kürzlich ein Auto gekauft haben, bewahren Sie Ihre Darlehensabrechnungen auf.

segments.src: ## Records to Keep Now
segments.tr: ## Jetzt aufzubewahrende Aufzeichnungen

segments.src: The best way to claim these deductions is to document your income as you earn it.
segments.tr: Der beste Weg, diese Abzüge geltend zu machen, besteht darin, Ihr Einkommen zu dokumentieren, während Sie es verdienen.

segments.src: Consider these steps before the year ends:
segments.tr: Erwägen Sie diese Schritte, bevor das Jahr endet:

segments.src: 1. **Tipped workers:** Keep a daily log of cash tips, plus card and app tips. Save statements from your employer's payroll or point-of-sale system. If you work through a delivery or rideshare platform, download your year-end earnings summaries.
segments.tr: 1. **Trinkgeldarbeiter:** Führen Sie ein tägliches Protokoll über Bar Trinkgelder sowie Karten- und App-Trinkgelder. Speichern Sie Abrechnungen von der Lohn- oder Kassensystem Ihres Arbeitgebers. Wenn Sie über eine Liefer- oder Mitfahrplattform arbeiten, laden Sie Ihre Jahresultraste herunter.

segments.src: 2. **Overtime earners:** Keep your pay stubs. Make sure you can see regular hours, overtime hours and the overtime rate. Ask your payroll department how overtime is labeled.
segments.tr: 2. **Überstundenverdiener:** Bewahren Sie Ihre Lohnabrechnungen auf. Stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie reguläre Stunden, Überstunden und den Überstundensatz sehen können. Fragen Sie Ihre Lohnbuchhaltung, wie Überstunden gekennzeichnet sind.

segments.src: 3. **Older adults:** Confirm your date of birth and Social Security number on all your tax records. If you are married, confirm the same for your spouse.
segments.tr: 3. **Ältere Erwachsene:** Bestätigen Sie Ihr Geburtsdatum und Ihre Sozialversicherungsnummer in all Ihren Steuerunterlagen. Wenn Sie verheiratet sind, bestätigen Sie dasselbe für Ihren Ehepartner.

segments.src: 4. **Car buyers:** Save the loan agreement, the vehicle identification number (VIN) and interest statements.
segments.tr: 4. **Autokäufer:** Bewahren Sie den Darlehensvertrag, die Fahrzeug-Identifizierungsnummer (VIN) und Zinsabrechnungen auf.

segments.src: 5. **Everyone:** Look at your last pay stub of the year and compare it with the W-2 you receive in January. The IRS has been working with employers on new reporting. Expect separate reporting for qualified tips and overtime, but not every employer will have fully adapted. If your W-2 does not break out these amounts, you may need your own records to support the deduction.
segments.tr: 5. **Jeder:** Betrachten Sie Ihre letzte Lohnabrechnung des Jahres und vergleichen Sie sie mit dem W-2, den Sie im Januar erhalten. Der IRS arbeitet mit Arbeitgebern an neuen Berichterstattungen. Erwarten Sie eine separate Berichterstattung für qualifizierte Trinkgelder und Überstunden, aber nicht jeder Arbeitgeber wird sich vollständig angepasst haben. Wenn Ihr W-2 diese Beträge nicht aufschlüsselt, benötigen Sie möglicherweise eigene Aufzeichnungen, um den Abzug zu unterstützen.

segments.src: ## How Withholding Could Affect Your Refund
segments.tr: ## Wie sich der Steuerabzug auf Ihre Erstattung auswirken könnte

segments.src: Your refund is simply the difference between what was withheld from your pay during the year and what you actually owe.
segments.tr: Ihre Erstattung ist einfach die Differenz zwischen dem, was während des Jahres von Ihrem Lohn einbehalten wurde, und dem, was Sie tatsächlich schulden.

segments.src: These new deductions reduce what you owe.
segments.tr: Diese neuen Abzüge reduzieren, was Sie schulden.

segments.src: They do not automatically reduce what your employer withholds, unless you or your employer adjusts it.
segments.tr: Sie reduzieren nicht automatisch, was Ihr Arbeitgeber einbehält, es sei denn, Sie oder Ihr Arbeitgeber passen es an.

segments.src: - **If your withholding did not change,** you may be overpaying during the year and get a **larger refund** after you claim the deductions.
segments.tr: - **Wenn sich Ihr Steuerabzug nicht geändert hat,** zahlen Sie möglicherweise während des Jahres zu viel und erhalten nach Geltendmachung der Abzüge eine **größere Erstattung**.

segments.src: - **If you want more take-home pay now,** you can submit a new Form W-4 to your employer, using the deductions worksheet to account for the new deductions. The IRS Tax Withholding Estimator at IRS.gov can help you pick sensible numbers.
segments.tr: - **Wenn Sie jetzt mehr Nettolohn wünschen,** können Sie Ihrem Arbeitgeber ein neues Formular W-4 einreichen und dabei das Abzugsarbeitsblatt verwenden, um die neuen Abzüge zu berücksichtigen. Der IRS Tax Withholding Estimator auf IRS.gov kann Ihnen helfen, vernünftige Zahlen auszuwählen.

segments.src: - **If you are self-employed or have income without withholding,** the deductions may reduce your quarterly estimated payments. Do not reduce them too far, though, because underpayment penalties can apply.
segments.tr: - **Wenn Sie selbstständig sind oder Einkommen ohne Steuerabzug haben,** können die Abzüge Ihre vierteljährlichen geschätzten Zahlungen reduzieren. Reduzieren Sie sie jedoch nicht zu stark, da Unterzahlungsstrafen anfallen können.

segments.src: - **Be careful about guessing.** Cutting withholding too much because you expect a deduction can leave you owing money in the spring. That is a risk if you hit the income phase-out, change jobs, or work fewer overtime hours than you expected.
segments.tr: - **Seien Sie vorsichtig beim Schätzen.** Den Steuerabzug zu stark zu kürzen, weil Sie einen Abzug erwarten, kann dazu führen, dass Sie im Frühjahr Geld schulden. Das ist ein Risiko, wenn Sie die Einkommensausgrenzung erreichen, den Job wechseln oder weniger Überstunden arbeiten als erwartet.

segments.src: A refund is not a bonus from the government.
segments.tr: Eine Erstattung ist kein Bonus von der Regierung.

segments.src: It is your own money returned after the year ends.
segments.tr: Es ist Ihr eigenes Geld, das nach Ende des Jahres zurückgegeben wird.

segments.src: Deciding between a big refund and a bigger paycheck is a personal budgeting choice.
segments.tr: Die Entscheidung zwischen einer großen Erstattung und einem größeren Gehaltsscheck ist eine persönliche Budgetierungsentscheidung.

segments.src: ## Common Mistakes to Avoid
segments.tr: ## Häufige Fehler, die es zu vermeiden gilt

segments.src: - **Assuming every overtime dollar is deductible.** Only the premium portion of FLSA-required overtime counts.
segments.tr: - **Anzunehmen, dass jeder Überstundendollar abzugsfähig ist.** Nur der Prämienteil der vom FLSA geforderten Überstunden zählt.

segments.src: - **Forgetting the income limits.** Higher earners may get a reduced deduction or none.
segments.tr: - **Vergessen der Einkommensgrenzen.** Besserverdiener erhalten möglicherweise einen reduzierten Abzug oder gar keinen.

segments.src: - **Filing separately as a married couple.** This can disqualify you from some of these deductions.
segments.tr: - **Getrennte Veranlagung als verheiratetes Paar.** Dies kann Sie von einigen dieser Abzüge ausschließen.

segments.src: - **Claiming unreported tips without records.** The IRS may ask you to show how you arrived at the number.
segments.tr: - **Geltendmachung nicht gemeldeter Trinkgelder ohne Aufzeichnungen.** Der IRS fordert Sie möglicherweise auf zu zeigen, wie Sie auf die Zahl gekommen sind.

segments.src: - **Ignoring state taxes.** State rules differ. Some states follow the federal changes, while others do not.
segments.tr: - **Ignorieren von Landessteuern.** Die Regeln der Bundesstaaten unterscheiden sich. Einige Bundesstaaten folgen den Bundesänderungen, andere nicht.

segments.src: ## What to Do Next
segments.tr: ## Was als Nächstes zu tun ist

segments.src: 1. Check whether your job appears on the IRS tipped-occupation list, or whether your overtime is FLSA-required.
segments.tr: 1. Überprüfen Sie, ob Ihr Job auf der IRS-Liste der Trinkgeldberufe erscheint oder ob Ihre Überstunden vom FLSA gefordert sind.

segments.src: 2. Estimate your MAGI to see whether phase-outs could apply.
segments.tr: 2. Schätzen Sie Ihr MAGI, um zu sehen, ob Ausphasungen gelten könnten.

segments.src: 3. Run the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator and decide whether to adjust your W-4.
segments.tr: 3. Führen Sie den IRS Tax Withholding Estimator aus und entscheiden Sie, ob Sie Ihr W-4 anpassen möchten.

segments.src: 4. Organize your records into one folder, paper or digital, before January.
segments.tr: 4. Organisieren Sie Ihre Unterlagen vor Januar in einem Ordner, ob in Papierform oder digital.

segments.src: 5. When filing, use reputable tax software or a licensed preparer, and compare the results against the official IRS instructions.
segments.tr: 5. Verwenden Sie beim Einreichen eine renommierte Steuersoftware oder einen lizenzierten Ersteller und vergleichen Sie die Ergebnisse mit den offiziellen IRS-Anweisungen.

segments.src: The new deductions can lower the tax bill for many workers and retirees, but they are not automatic and not unlimited.
segments.tr: Die neuen Abzüge können die Steuerrechnung für viele Arbeitnehmer und Rentner senken, aber sie sind nicht automatisch und nicht unbegrenzt.

segments.src: A little record-keeping in the coming weeks can make filing season go much more smoothly.
segments.tr: Ein wenig Buchhaltung in den kommenden Wochen kann die Einreichungssaison viel reibungsloser verlaufen lassen.

segments.tr: *Zu konsultierende Quellen: IRS.gov-Leitfaden zum One Big Beautiful Bill Act, die Anweisungen zum Formular W-4 und der Tax Withholding Estimator.
